Ferse; Lith. kulnis; Hib. cairine; Lat. crus ?]. —चर-ण-कमल or चरण-किशलय, अम्, n. a lotus-foot (lit. foot-lotus), a beautiful foot, the foot of a lover, of a deity, &c. —चरण-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen at one's feet, prostrate. —चरण-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. the joint of the foot, the ancle. —चरण-दास, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Guruśiṣya-saṃvāda and of the poems entitled Nāciketūpākhyāna. —चरण-न्यास, अस्, m. the trace of a foot, foot-step. —चरण-प, अस्, m. a tree. —चरण-पतन, अम्, n. falling at the feet, prostration. —चरण-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen at the feet, prostrate. —चरण-पद्म, अस् or अम्, m. n. a lotus (like) foot, the foot of a deity or lover. —चरण-पर्वन्, अ, n. ‘foot-joint,’ the ancle. —चरण-पात, अस्, m. tread, trampling; foot-fall. —चरण-युग, अम्, n. both the feet; two lines of a stanza. —चरण-व्यूह, अस्, m. title of a treatise. —चरण-शुश्रूषा, f. prostration. —चरण-सेवा, f. service, devotion. —चरणानमित (°ण-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, bent or bowed under the feet, trodden down. —चरणा-भरण (°ण-आभ्°), अम्, n. an ornament for the feet. —चरणामृत (°ण-अम्°), अम्, n. foot-nectar,’ the water in which the feet of a Brāhman or spiritual guide have been washed. —चरणायध (°ण-आय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the feet for weapons; (अस्), m. a cock. —चरणारविन्द (°ण-अर्°), अम्, n. the lotus (like) foot (of a deity, lover, &c.). —चरणार्ध (°ण-अर्°), अम्, n. the half of the foot; half of the fourth of a stanza. —चरणास्कन्दन (°ण-आस्°), अम्, n. trampling, treading down with the feet. —च-रणोदक (°ण-उद्°), अम्, n. water in which the feet of a venerable Brāhman or spiritual teacher have been washed. —चरणोपग (°ण-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, in contact with the feet, at the feet.
चरणीय: चरणीय, nom. A., Ved. चरणीयते, to follow, perform, be engaged in, carry on; (Sāy.) to desire to go.
चरण्य: 1. चरण्य, nom. P. चरण्यति, to move.
2. चरण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, foot-like, like a foot.
चरण्यु: चरण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. moving, movable.
चरत्: चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, moving, going on; pro-ceeding, acting, practising.
चरथ: चरथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moving, living; capable of moving, movable; (अस्, अम्), m. n. going, moving, wan-dering; movableness; liveliness, life; a going, a way.
चराचर: 2. चराचर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चर् reduplicated; for 1. see P. 317, col. 3), moving locomotive, running; trembling, shaking, unsteady; wished, desired; (अम्), n., N. of a small shell; [cf. कपर्द।]
चरि: चरि, इस्, m. an animal in general.
चरित: चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, gone to, attained, prac-tised; (अम्), n. going, moving, course; acting, doing, practice, behaviour, acts, deeds, practices, adventures, ‘res gestæ;’ story; nature; fixed institute, proper or peculiar observance; [cf. उत्तर-राम-चरित, दुश्-चरित, सच्-च्°, सह-च्, सु-च्°।] —चरित-गुणत्व, अम्, n. (?) accompaniment, assistance; meritorious conduct. —चरित-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, (at the end of compounds) containing or relating deeds or adven-tures, made up of deeds. —चरित-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, performing an act of devotion. —चरितार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, attaining one's object, success-ful in an undertaking, satisfied, effected, successful. —चरितार्थ-त्व, अम्, n. the attainment of an aim, successfulness, success. —चरितार्थय, nom. P. चरि-तार्थयति, to cause a person to attain his aim. —च-रितार्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, desirous of success.
चरितव्य: चरितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone, to be managed; to be followed or observed; to be practised or per-formed.
चरित्र: चरित्र, अम्, n. a foot, leg; going; acting, behaving, behaviour, habit, practice, acts, deeds, proceedings, exploits; instituted and peculiar observance or con-duct; adventures, story, history or account of any one's deeds or exploits; nature, disposition; (आ), f. the tamarind tree; [cf. चारित्र।] —चरित्र-बन्-धक, अस्, m. a friendly pledge, one of unequal value to the loan. —चरित्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, expe-rienced, familiar with customs.
चरिष्णु: चरिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, capable of moving, movable, locomotive, active, unsteady, wandering about; (उस्), m., N. of a son of Manu Sāvarṇa; also of a son of Kīrttimat and Dhenukā. —चरिष्णु-धूम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having moving smoke, whose smoke goes everywhere.
चरीत्र: चरीत्र, अम्, n. behaviour, conduct, practice; [cf. चरित्र।]
चर्तव्य: चर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be practised &c.; [cf. चरितव्य।]
चर्य: चर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone; to be practised or performed &c.; (आ), f. going about, wandering, walk-ing about, driving or going in a carriage; pervading, visiting; course; proceeding, behaviour; due and regular observance of all rites or customs, following the rules of studentship; practising religious austeri-ties, wandering about as a mendicant; performing, practising, engaging in, practice, conduct [cf. कु-चर्या]; behaviour, deportment, usage; eating; (अम्), n. going about, wandering, driving in a carriage &c.; proceeding, behaviour, conduct; [cf. ब्रह्म-चर्य, भिक्षा-च्°, भैक्ष्य-च्°।] —चर्यावतार (°या-अव्°), अस्, m. title of a Buddhist work.
चार: चार, अस्, m. a spy &c. See s. v.

चार चार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चर्), = चर, a spy, scout, secret agent or emissary, messenger; going, motion, progression, course; wandering about, travelling; proceeding; performing, practising; bind-ing, a bond, fetter; a prison, a house of confinement; the tree Buchanania Latifolia, = पियाल; (अम्), n. a factitious poison, (for वार); [cf. Lat. carcer.] —चार-काण्ड, अम्, n. ascensional difference (in astronomy). —चार-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, ‘spy-eyed,’ i. e. a king or minister who uses spies as his eyes, one who employs spies or agents and sees through their medium; (उस्), n. espionage. —चार-चण, अस्, आ, अम्, graceful in gait or motion. —चार-चुञ्चु, उस्, उस्, उ, graceful in walking, of graceful carriage. —चार-ज्या, f. the sine of the ascensional difference. —चार-पथ, अस्, m. a place where two roads meet. —चार-भट, अस्, m. a valorous warrior. —चार-वायु, उस्, m. summer air, zephyr. —चारान्-तरित (°र-अन्°), अस्, m. a secret emissary or spy. —चारेक्षण (°र-ईक्°), अस्, m. a statesman, a minister or king (who employs spies).
चरट: चरट चरट, अस्, m. a wagtail; (ई), f. = चरण्टी, चिरिण्टी, चिरण्टी।
चरम: चरम चरम, अस्, आ, अम्, m. pl. चरमे or चरमास्, (said to be fr. rt. चर्), last, hinder, ultimate, final; outermost; western, west; lowest, least; imme-diately following; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a particular high number; (अम्), ind. at last, at the end; चरमा क्रिया, the final ceremony, the funeral ceremony. —चरम-काल, अस्, m. the last moments, the hour of death. —चरम-क्ष्माभृत्, त्, m. the western mountain behind which the sun and moon are supposed to set. —चरम-वैयाकरण, अस्, m. an ignorant grammarian. —चरम-शैर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having the head towards the west. —च-रमाचल (°म-अच्°), अस्, m. or चरमाद्रि (°म-अद्°), इस्, m. = चरम-क्ष्माभृत् above. —चर-माजा (°म-अजा), f., Ved. the last or smallest she-goat. —चरमावस्था (°म-अव्°), f. the last state.
चरम्य: चरम्य, nom. P. चरम्यति, to be the last.
चरव्य: चरव्य चरव्य। See below under चरु।
चरव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, destined for the Caru oblation.
चरु: चरु चरु, उस्, m. a kind of vessel in which a particular oblation is prepared, a saucepan, pot, kettle; a cloud; an oblation of rice, barley, and pulse, boiled with butter and milk for presentation to the gods or manes. —चरु-चेलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having portions of offerings on the clothes (?); an epithet of Śiva; (perhaps a wrong form for चारुचेलिन्।) —चरु-व्रण, अस्, m. a kind of cake. —चरु-श्रपण, अम्, n. sprinkling an oblation of milk and ghee. —चरु-स्थाली, f. the vessel in which an oblation is prepared, made either of clay or of udumbara-wood. —चरु-होम, अस्, m. an oblation of a meat-offering.
चर्करीत: चर्करीत चर्करीत, अम्, n. (fr. 1. कृ, to do), a term used by Yāska and others for the intensive verb formed without the syllable य।
चर्कृति: चर्कृति चर्कृति, इस्, f. (fr. 2. कृ), Ved. praising, mention, glory, praise.
चर्कृत्य: चर्कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be mentioned with praise, worthy of praise, renowned.
चर्घ्: चर्घ् चर्घ्, cl. 1. P. चर्घति, &c., to go or move.
चर्च्: चर्च् चर्च्, cl. 10. P. चर्चयति, to repeat (a word in reciting the Veda), to read, recite, study, peruse carefully, consider; cl. 1. or 6. P. चर्चति, &c., to speak, say, abuse, reprove, condemn, censure, menace; to injure or hurt, to inquire.
चर्च: चर्च, अस्, m. considering, deliberation, i. e. re-peating over in thought; (आ), f. repetition of a word, recitation, incidental mention, popular talk, alternate recitation of a poem by two persons; reflection, con-sideration; the exercise of judgment or deliberation, inquiry, investigation; an epithet of the goddess Durgā; covering or cleansing the body with unguents, smearing with ointment; bribery (?).
चर्चक: चर्चक, अस्, आ, अम्, repeating, the repeater (of a word in the recitation of the Veda).
चर्चन: चर्चन, अम्, n. repeating, repetition; covering the body with unguents.
चर्चाय: चर्चाय, nom. P. चर्चायते, to undergo repe-tition, to be repeated.
चर्चि: चर्चि, इस्, f., Ved. repetition of words in recitation; (इस्), m., N. of a man.
चर्चिका: चर्चिका, f. deliberation, inquiry; cleaning the person with perfumes, an epithet of the goddess Durgā or Cāmuṇḍā; [cf. घर्म-चर्चिका and वि-चर्चिका।]
चर्चिक्य: चर्चिक्य, अम्, n. anointing the body, an unguent, = चार्चिक्य and चर्चा।
चर्चित: चर्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, perfumed, anointed, smeared with sandal &c., covered with anything; inquired into or after, investigated; sought, desired; (अम्), n. the being covered or anointed (with anything).
चर्चर: चर्चर चर्चर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. चर्), Ved. going; (ई), f. a kind of song; striking the hands to beat time; musical symphony; the recitation of scholars; festive cries or merriment, festive sport; a festival; flattery, dishonest praise; a kind of metre consisting of four lines of eighteen syllables each; curled or woolly hair.
चर्चरिका: चर्चरिका, f. a kind of gesture, gesticulation.
चर्चरीक: चर्चरीक, अस्, m. a pot-herb; decoration or curling of the hair [cf. चर्चरी]; a form of Śiva.
चर्चस्: चर्चस् चर्चस्, आस्, m., N. of one of the nine treasures of Kuvera.
चर्तन: चर्तन चर्तन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. चृत्), Ved. stringing together; (अम्), n. a hook, a pin.
चर्त्य: चर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be strung or tied in regular order; to be hurt or injured.
चर्पट: चर्पट चर्पट, अस्, m. the open palm of the hand with fingers extended; a kind of plant, Mollugo Pentaphylla; a quantity of bubbles or specks (स्फार-विपुल); (ई), f. a thin cake or biscuit of flour; [cf. पर्पटी।]
चर्पटि: चर्पटि चर्पटि, इस्, m., N. of an author; (also read चर्पटिन्।)
चर्ब्: चर्ब् चर्ब्, cl. 1. P. चर्बति, to go, move.
चर्भट: चर्भट चर्भट, अस्, m. a kind of cucumber, Cucumis Utilissimus [cf. एर्वारु; cf. also चिर्भटी and चिर्भिटा]; (ई), f. = चर्चरी, the noise of merri-ment or festivity, cries of joy.
चर्म: चर्म चर्म, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. चर्), Ved. a hide, a skin; a shield. See चर्मन् below.
चर्मण्य: चर्मण्य, अम्, n. (fr. the next), leather-work.
चर्मन्: चर्मन्, अ, n. skin, leather, hide bark, parchment, &c.; the hide of an antelope &c. used as a seat or bed by the religious student; a shield; [cf. गल-चर्-मन्, दुश्-चर्मन्, &c.; cf. also Lat. corium, cal-ceus (?); Hib. croicionn; Gr. πέλμα.] —चर्म-करण, अम्, n. working in skins or leather. —चर्-म-कशा or चर्म-कषा or चर्म-कसा, f. ‘skin-injurer,’ a plant, commonly called Carmakaṣā or Car-maghās, Mimosa Abstergens; a particular kind of per-fume. —चर्म-कार, अस्, m. a shoe-maker, a currier or worker in leather, the offspring of a Caṇḍāla woman by a man of the fisherman caste, or of a Vaideha female by a Niṣāda; (ई), f. the wife of the preceding; N. of a plant, = चर्म-कशा. —चर्म-कारक, अस्, m. a worker in leather. —चर्म-कारिन्, ई, m. a currier, skinner, shoe-maker, worker in hides or leather. —चर्-म-कार्य, अम्, n. working in leather or skins. —चर्-म-कील, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wart; excrescences con-sidered as a kind of hemorrhoids. —चर्म-कृत्, त्, m. a shoe-maker. —चर्म-खाण्डिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (perhaps for चर्म-खण्डिक ?); [cf. चर्म-मण्डल and चर्म-रङ्ग।] —चर्म-ग्रीव, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Śiva. —चर्म-चटक, अस्, आ, m. f. or चर्म-चटिका, f. or चर्म-चटी, f. a bat. —चर्म-चित्रक, अम्, n. white leprosy (श्वेत-कुष्ठ). —चर्म-चेल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a garment with the hide turned outwards. —चर्म-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, coming forth from the skin, produced by or from the skin; (अम्), n. the hairs of the body; blood. —चर्मण्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. furnished with hide, covered with skin or leather; [cf. भूर्ज।] —चर्म-नासिका, f. ‘a leather thong,’ a whip. —चर्म-पट्टिका, f. a flat piece of leather for play-ing upon with dice, a leather backgammon board &c. —चर्म-पत्त्रा, f. a bat, the small house-bat. —चर्म-पादुका, f. a leather shoe. —चर्म-प्रभेदिका, f. a shoe-maker's awl. —चर्म-प्रसे-वक, अस्, इका, m. f. a bellows. —चर्म-बन्ध, अस्, m. a leather band or strap. —चर्म-मण्डल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —चर्म -मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of skin or leather, leathern, encased in leather. —चर्म-मुण्डा, f. a form of the goddess Durgā, commonly चामुण्डा and चण्ड-मुण्डा। —चर्म-म्न, अस्, m., Ved. a tanner. —चर्म-यष्टि, इस्, f. a whip; [cf. चर्म-दण्ड।] —चर्म-रङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of a people in the north-west of Madhya-deśa; (आ), f., N. of a plant, = आवर्तकी। —चर्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, covered with hides or skins; (आन्), m., N. of a warrior. —चर्म-वसन, अस्, आ, अम्, clothed in skin; चर्मरु: चर्मरु, उस्, m. a shoe-maker, a worker in leather; [cf. चर्मार and चर्म-कार।]
चर्मार: चर्मार, अस्, m. a worker in leather, a shoe-maker.
चर्मिक: चर्मिक, अस्, आ, अम्, armed with a shield, a shield-bearer.
चर्मिन्: चर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, covered with skin or parchment, having a hide or skin; leather, leathern, made of leather, &c.; armed with a shield; (ई), m. a soldier armed with a shield, a shield-bearer; N. of a tree, the bark of which is used for writing upon, &c. [cf. भूर्ज]; a plantain; N. of an attendant of Śiva.
चर्मरी: चर्मरी चर्मरी, f., N. of a plant with a poisonous fruit.

चर्वण: चर्वण, अस्, आ, अम्, chewing; (अम्), n. chewing, masticating; sipping, tasting; food which must be chewed, solid food.
चर्वणीय: चर्वणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, masticable, proper to be chewed.

चर्व्य: चर्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be chewed, chewable; (अम्), n. solid food requiring mastication.
चर्वन्: चर्वन् चर्वन्, आ, m. a blow with the flat of the hand.
चर्षणि: चर्षणि चर्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (said by some to be derived fr. कृष्; by other native commentators connected with rt. चक्ष्। to see, and so probably derived by Yāska, who explains चर्षणि by चायितृ, q. v.; other scholars connect it with rt. चर्), Ved. seeing, observing; discerning, moving, movable, run-ning, going in a carriage, agile, active, swift; (अयस्), f. pl. men, people, race, nation (e. g. पञ्च चर्ष-णयस्, the five races of men, the five nations; cf. कृष्टि, क्षिति, जन); ‘beings endowed with dis-cernment,’ N. of the children of Aryaman and Mā-trikā, who are regarded in the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa as the progenitors of the human race; (ई), f. a disloyal wife; N. of the wife of Varuṇa and mother of Bhṛgu; [cf. वि-च्° and विश्व-च्°।] —चर्षणि-प्रा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. governing men or people or races of men, epithet of Indra. —चर्षणी-धृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. supporting or protecting men or races of men; epithet of Indra, Mitra, Varuṇa, and the Viśve-devās. —चर्षणी-धृति, इस्, f., Ved. support or protection of men or races. —चर्षणी-सह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. ruling over or overpowering men; (Sāy.) overpowering enemies.
चल्: चल् चल् [cf. चट् and चर्], cl. 1. P. P. चल-यति or चालयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to move, to move, shake, jog, nudge, push, agitate, disturb; to turn off from, to cause to deviate, lead away from; cause to fall; drive away, remove or expel from; to cherish, foster, (wrong form for बल्): Pass. of Caus. चाल्यते, to be moved: Desid. चिचलिषति: Intens. चञल्यते or चाचल्यते, चाचल्ति; [cf. Gr. κέλω, κέλλω, ὀ-κέλλω, κέλης; Lat. celer, pro-cello, ex-cello, prœ-cello; calco, calc-s, calcar; Hib. caill, ‘a path;’ Germ. falle; Gr. πάλλω, πέλω; Lat. pello.]
चल: चल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, trembling, tremulous, movable, shaking, loose, unfixed, unsteady, fickle, fluctuating, perishable, disturbed, confused; (अस्), m. agitation, shaking, trembling; wind; quicksilver; (आ), f. lightning; incense; fortune or Lakṣmī the goddess of fortune; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of eighteen syllables each; [cf. अ-चल, निश्-चल, चाल।] —चल-कर्ण, अस्, m. the true distance of a planet from the earth. —चल-कृति, इस्, इस्, इ, unsteady, wanton. —चल-केतु, उस्, m. (in astron.) N. of a moving Ketu. —चल-चञ्चु, उस्, m., N. of the Greek partridge, Perdix Rufa; [cf. चकोर।] —चल-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fickle-minded, inconstant; (अम्), n. fickleness, mutability. —चलचित्त-ता, f. or चलचित्त-त्व, अम्, n. fickleness of mind, unsteadi-ness, inconstancy, mutability, frivolity. —चल-ता, f. or चल-त्र, अम्, n. shaking, trembling, a tremulous motion, pulsation. —चल-दन्त, अस्, m. a loose tooth. —चल-दल, अस्, m. the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa; [cf. अश्वत्थ।] —चल-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the Ficus Religiosa; [cf. अश्वत्थ।] —चल-सन्धि, इस्, m. movable articulation of the bones, Diarthrosis.  — 1. चलाचल (°ल-अच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, movable and immovable, locomotive and stationary. —चलातङ्क (°ल+आत्°), अस्, m. rheumatism. —चलात्मन् (°ल-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, fickle-minded, inconstant. —चलेन्द्रिय (°ल-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having unsteady organs, sensi-tive, sensual, not having subdued senses or passions. —चलेषु (°ल-इषु), उस्, उस्, उ, one whose arrow wavers or flies unsteadily.
चलत्: चलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, moving. —चलत्-पदम्। ind. moving, walking. —चलत्-पूर्णिमा, f. a small fish called Chanda, = चन्द्र-चञ्चल. —चलद्-अङ्ग or चलद्-अङ्गक, अस्, m. a fish, a sort of gilt-head, commonly Ceṅgā, Ophiocephalus Aurantiacus.
चलन: चलन, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, movable, trembling tremulous, shaking; (अस्), m. a foot; a deer, an antelope; (ई), f. a short petticoat worn by common women; the rope for tying an elephant; (अम्), n. a shaking motion, shaking, trembling; walking about, wandering, roaming; turning off from, leaving off.
चलनक: चलनक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. a short petticoat worn by women of low rank; (इका), f. silken fringes.
चलनीय: चलनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be moved or shaken, movable.
चलमान: चलमान, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving, proceeding, shaking, &c.
चलाचल: 2. चलाचल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. चल् with reduplica-tion), moving to and fro, movable, tremulous, unfixed, unsteady, shaking, loose; variable; (अस्), m. a cow.
चलित: चलित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, departed, proceeded (often used like a past tense, e. g. स चलितः, he started off, he departed); shaking, trembling.
चलितव्य: चलितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone away; to be moved, movable.
चलु: चलु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. चल्), water hastily taken up in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing the mouth &c.; a handful or mouthful of water; [cf. गण्डूष।]
चलुक: चलुक, अस्, m. = the preceding; also a small pot, a gallipot, &c.; N. of a man; [cf. चुलुक।]
चलद्विष: चलद्विष चलद्विष, अस्, m. the Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
चलि: चलि चलि, इस्, m. a cover, a wrapper, a surtout; [cf. चोल।]
चवि: चवि चवि, इस्, ई, f. or चविक, अम्, आ, n. f. or चव्या, अम्, f. n. a species of the pepper plant, Piper Chaba; Orris root.
चशाति: चशाति चशाति, a wrong reading for व-शाति, q. v.
चष्: चष् चष्, cl. 1. P. A. चषति, -ते, to eat; to kill, hurt.
चषक: चषक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a vessel used for drinking spirits, a wine glass &c., any drinking-vessel; spirituous liquor; honey.
चषति: चषति, इस्, m. eating; killing; decay, infirmity.
चषाल: चषाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wooden ring on the top of a sacrificial post; an iron ring at the base of the post; (अस्), m. a hive. —चषाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. furnished with a Caṣāla.
चष्ट: चष्ट चष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (past passive part. fr. चक्ष् ?), spoken, asked.
चष्टान: चष्टान चष्टान, अस्, m., N. of a prince, (= Τιαστανος ?).
चह्: चह् चह् [cf. चप्], cl. 1. 10. P. चहति, अचहीत्, चहयति, -यितुम्, to be wicked, commit wickedness; to cheat; to be proud; cl. 10. P. चहयति, to grind, pound, knead; [cf. Hib. cagnaim, ‘I chew, gnaw.’]
चाकचिच्चा: चाकचिच्चा चाकचिच्चा, f., N. of a plant, = श्वेत-वह्ना।
चाक्र: चाक्र चाक्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चक्र), carried on (as a battle) with the discus; circular, belonging to a wheel &c.; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
चाक्रवर्मण: चाक्रवर्मण, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. चक्र-वर्मन्), N. of a grammarian.
चाक्रवाकेय: चाक्रवाकेय, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n.? (fr. चक्र-वाक), N. of a place.
चाक्रायण: चाक्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic of Uṣasta.
चाक्रिक: चाक्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, circular; belonging to a wheel or discus; relating to a company or circle; (अस्), m. a potter; an oil-maker; a proclaimer; a chorister, a bard who chants in chorus the praises of kings, heroes, gods, &c.; a coachman, a driver; (आस्), m. pl. companions, followers.
चाक्रिण: चाक्रिण, अस्, m. the son of a potter or oil-maker.
चाक्रेय: चाक्रेय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a wheel or discus; (अस्, अम्), m. or n. (?), N. of a place.
चाक्षुष: चाक्षुष चाक्षुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चक्षुस्), consisting in sight, depending on or produced from it; belonging to the eye. visual, optical, perceptible by the eye, visible, seen; relating to Manu Cākṣuṣa; चाक्षुषी विद्या, that magical science which gives the power of seeing anything; (अस्), m., N. of the sixth Manu who with five other Manus is a son of Manu Svāyambhuva, or according to other authorities a son of Viśva-karman and Ākṛti, or a son of Cakṣus; N. of a son of Ripu and Bṛhatī, (according to some he is called Cakṣuṣa, and is father of Manu Cākṣuṣa); N. of a son of Kakṣeyu and brother of Sabhānara; also of a son of Anu and brother of Sabhānara; also of a son of Khanitra; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of deities in the fourteenth Manvantara; (अम्), n. knowledge which depends on vision. —चाक्षुष-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ocular evidence. —चा-क्षुष-त्व, अम्, n. perceptibility by sight.
चाक्ष्म: चाक्ष्म चाक्ष्म, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. क्षम्), Ved. forbearing, gracious.
चाङ्ग: चाङ्ग चाङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. चङ्ग), wood-sorrel; whiteness or beauty of the teeth.
चाङ्गेरी: चाङ्गेरी, f. wood-sorrel, Oxalis Pusilla; [cf. कु-चाङ्गेरी।]
चाचपुट: चाचपुट चाचपुट, अस्, m. a kind of time in music; [cf. चच्चपुट।]
चाचलि: चाचलि चाचलि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. Intens. of rt. चल्), moving much or repeatedly; [cf. वि-चाचलि and अ-विच्°।]
चाञ्चल्य: चाञ्चल्य चाञ्चल्य, अम्, n. (fr. चञ्चल), tremulousness, unsteadiness; transitoriness, fugitive-ness, fidgetiness.
चाट: चाट चाट, अस्, m. (fr. चट् = चत् ?), a cheat, a rogue, a speculator, one who makes away with or embezzles money &c. entrusted to him.
चाटकैर: चाटकैर चाटकैर, अस्, m. (fr. चटक or चटका), a young sparrow.
चाटलिका: चाटलिका चाटलिका, f., N. of a place.
चाटिग्राम: चाटिग्राम चाटिग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a place.
चाटु: चाटु चाटु, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. चट्), pleasing or grateful words or discourse, flattery, flattering, coaxing; distinct or clear speech; [cf. चतु।] —चाटु-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, speaking agreeably or kindly, flattering, complying with a request, humouring, complaisant; (अस्), m. a flatterer. —चाटु-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking agreeably, flattering. —चाटु-पटु, उस्, m. a jester, a buffoon, one who makes compliments (?). —चाटु-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, elegantly tremulous. —चाटु-वटु, उस्, m. a jester; [cf. चाटु-पटु।] —चाटु-शत, अम्, n. repeated coax-ing, a hundred entreaties. —चाटूक्ति (°टु-उक्ति), इस्, f. agreeable language, flattery, service.
चाटुक: चाटुक, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), pleasing or grateful discourse.
चाणकीन: चाणकीन चाणकीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चणक), fit for or sown with the chick-pea (a field &c.).
चाणक्य: चाणक्य चाणक्य, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. चणक, N. of a Muni), N. of the sage Vātsyāyana; N. of a celebrated Brāhman also called Viṣṇu-gupta, the reputed author of a work on morals and the princi-ples of government. He is said to have destroyed the Nanda dynasty and to have made Candra-gupta (q. v.) king, whose minister he became. From the tone of his advice to princes he has been styled the Machiavelli of India; (अम्), n., scil. शास्त्रम्, the work of Cāṇakya, on morals and polity. —चाणक्य-मूलक, अम्, n. a kind of radish; [cf. कौटिल्य।] —चाणक्य-श्लोक, आस्, m. pl. detached stanzas on morals and the principles of government, supposed to be written by the Brāhman Cāṇakya or compiled by him.
चाणक: चाणक, अस्, ई, अम् (an adj. formed fr. चाणक्य), relating to Cāṇakya.
चाणूर: चाणूर चाणूर, अस्, m., N. of a prince; also of a wrestler in the service of Kaṃsa, slain by Kṛṣṇa, and identified with the Daitya Varāha. —चाणूर-सूदन, अस्, m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
चाण्ड: चाण्ड चाण्ड, अम्, n. (fr. चण्ड), violence.
चाण्डाल: चाण्डाल चाण्डाल, अस्, m. = चण्डाल, a name of an impure or degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah, an outcast; (ई), f. a woman of the same tribe; N. of a plant, = लिङ्गिनी।
चाण्डालिका: चाण्डालिका, f. a vulgar lute, the lute of the Caṇḍāla; a N. of Durgā; a kind of herb; [cf. चण्डालिका।] —चाण्डालिकाश्रम (°का-आश्°), अस्, m. N. of the hermitage of Cāṇḍālikā.
चातुर: चातुर 1. चातुर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्), re-lating to four; (a carriage &c.) drawn by four; (ई), f., N. of a poem by Nara-siṃha; (अम्), n. a carriage, a cart holding four people.

चातुर 2. चातुर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. चतुर), clever, able, ingenious, shrewd, sagacious; speaking well or kindly, flattering; perceptible, visible; govern-ing, ruling; (अस्), m. a small round pillow, see below; (ई), f. dexterity, ability, cleverness.
चातुःसागरिक: चातुःसागरिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुः-सागर), belonging to the four oceans.
चातुरक्ष: चातुरक्ष, अम्, n. (fr. चतुर्-अक्ष), four casts in playing at dice.
चातुरर्थिक: चातुरर्थिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्-अर्थ), used in four particular senses or meanings.
चातुराश्रमिक: चातुराश्रमिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or चातुराश्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. चतुर्-आश्रम), being in one of the four periods or orders [cf. आश्रम] of life.

चातुर्थक: चातुर्थक, अस्, इका, अम्, quartan, appearing every fourth day; (अस्), m. a quartan ague.
चातुर्थाह्निक: चातुर्थाह्निक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्थ-अहन्), belonging to the fourth day.
चातुर्थिक: चातुर्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the fourth or to the fourth day; (अस्), m. a quartan ague.
चातुर्दश: चातुर्दश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्दशी), appearing on the fourteenth day of the half month.
चातुर्दशिक: चातुर्दशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, reading the holy scrip-tures on the fourteenth day of the half month.
चातुर्दैव: चातुर्दैव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्-देव), sacred to four deities.
चातुर्भद्र: चातुर्भद्र, अम्, n. (fr. चतुर्-भद्र), an assemblage of four medicinal plants.
चातुर्भुजि: चातुर्भुजि, इस्, m. a son of Catur-bhuja.
चातुर्भौतिक: चातुर्भौतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्-भूत), consisting of four elements.
चातुर्महाराजकायिक: चातुर्महाराजकायिक or चातुर्महाराजिक = चतुर्महाराजकायिक; also an epithet of Viṣṇu.
चातुर्मास: चातुर्मास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्-मास), produced in four months.

चातुर्मासी: चातुर्मासी, f., scil. पौर्णमासी, the day of full moon at the Cāturmāsya sacrifices.

चातुर्वर्ण्य: चातुर्वर्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चतुर्-वर्ण), suited to the four tribes or castes, belonging to them (?); (अम्), n. the aggregate of the four original castes, viz. the Brāhman, Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, and Śūdra.
चातुर्विंशिक: चातुर्विंशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्विंश), be-longing to the twenty-fourth day.

चातुर्विध्य: चातुर्विध्य, अम्, n. (fr. चतुर्-विध), four kinds collectively.
चातुर्वैद्य: चातुर्वैद्य, अस्, दी, अम् (fr. चतुर्-वेद), versed in or familiar with the four Vedas; (अम्), n. know-ledge of the four Vedas.
चातुर्होतृक: चातुर्होतृक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुर्-होतृ), belong-ing to the Catur-hotṛ.

चातुष्काण्डिक: चातुष्काण्डिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुष्-काण्ड), divided into four parts.
चातुष्टय: चातुष्टय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चतुष्टय), knowing or familiar with the Catuṣṭaya.
चातुष्प्राश्य: चातुष्प्राश्य, अस्, शी, अम् (fr. चतुः + प्राश), enough for four persons to eat.

चात्वारिंशत्क: चात्वारिंशत्क, अस्, ई, अम्, bought for forty.

चातुरिक: चातुरिक, अस्, m. a charioteer, a coachman.
चातुर्य: चातुर्य, अम्, n. dexterity, cleverness, ability, shrewdness; amiableness.
चात्र: चात्र चात्र, अम्, n. (sometimes read चत्र), a cylinder of catechu-wood twelve Aṅgulas long, tipped at both ends with iron and furnished with an iron bolt, (this and another piece of wood called Auvīlī are used for producing the sacred fire.)
चात्वाल: चात्वाल चात्वाल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. the hole formed in the ground by excavating the earth to con-struct the Uttara-vedi or north altar; (अस्), m. a hollow place dug in the ground to receive a burnt-offer-ing; any hole in the ground; [cf. चत्वाल।] —चा-त्वाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, (a sacrifice) at which the Cātvāla is excavated.
चान्दनिक: चान्दनिक चान्दनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चन्दन), made of or derived from sandal, perfumed with it, &c.
चान्द्र: चान्द्र चान्द्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चन्द्र), lunar, relating to the moon, regulated by it, &c.; (अस्), m. a month, a lunar month (called Gauṇa, q. v., if reckoned from full moon to full moon, and Mukhya if reckoned from new moon to new moon); the light fortnight or half month, during which the moon is on the increase; the Candra-kānta or moon-gem; (आस्), m. pl. the pupils of the grammarian Candra; (ई), f. moonlight; a kind of solanum [cf. श्वेत-कण्टकारी]; N. of a princess; (अम्), n., scil. व्र-तम्, the Cāndrāyaṇa penance, see below. —चान्-द्र-मास, अस्, m. a lunar month; [cf. चान्द्र above.] —चान्द्र-वत्सर, अस्, m. the lunar year. —चान्द्र-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of a Sūtra work. —चान्द्राख्य (°र-आख्°), अम्, n. fresh ginger; [cf. चान्द्रक।]
चान्द्रक: चान्द्रक, अम्, n. dried ginger; [cf. शुण्ठी।]
चान्द्रपुर: चान्द्रपुर, आस्, m. pl. the inhabitants of Candra-pura.
चान्द्रभागा: चान्द्रभागा or ई f. = चन्द्र-भागा, the Che-nāb, a river in the Pañjāb.
चान्द्रमस: चान्द्रमस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चन्द्रमस्), lunar, relating or belonging to the moon; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Bṛhaspati; (अम्), n., N. of the fifth lunar mansion, the constellation Mṛga-śiras; the stars in Orion. —चान्द्रमसायन, अस्, or चान्द्रमसा-यनि, इस्, m. (fr. चन्द्रमस्), ‘descendant of the moon,’ a N. of Buddha, regent of Mercury and son of the moon.
चान्द्रव्रतिक: चान्द्रव्रतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चन्द्र-व्रत), acting in the manner of the moon, having the character of the moon.
चान्द्रायण: चान्द्रायण, अम्, n., scil. व्रतम्, a religious observance or expiatory penance regulated by the moon's age, (it consists in diminishing the daily con-sumption of food every day by one mouthful for the dark half of the month, beginning with 15 at the full moon until the quantity is reduced to O at the new moon, and then increasing it in like manner during the fortnight of the moon's increase: if this penance begins with the full moon, it is called Pipīlikā-madhya, i. e. having the middle thin like an ant; if with the new moon, beginning with O and increasing to 15, it is called Yava-madhya or Yava-madhyama, i. e. having the middle thick like a barley-corn); (आस्), m. pl., N. of various persons. —चान्द्रायण-भक्त, अम्, n. the country in-habited by the Cāndrāyaṇas. —चान्द्रायण-वि-धान or चान्द्रायण-व्रत, अम्, n. the penance called Cāndrāyaṇa.
चान्द्रायणिक: चान्द्रायणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, performing or a per-former of the Cāndrāyaṇa, q. v.
चान्धनायन: चान्धनायन चान्धनायन, अस्, m., N. of an ancient preceptor.
चाप: चाप चाप, अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps fr. rt. कप् = कम्प्), a bow; (in geometry) an arc or por-tion of a circle; the sign of the zodiac Sagittarius; a rainbow [cf. इन्द्र-चाप and शक्र-चाप]; N. of a particular constellation; [cf. धनुस्।] —चाप-दासी, f., N. of a river. —चाप-पट, अस्, m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia (पियाल); [cf. धनु and पट।]
चापिन्: चापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, armed with a bow; (ई), m. the sign of the zodiac Sagittarius.

चापल्य: चापल्य, अम्, n. fickleness; unsteadiness, transi-toriness; quickness, agitation, flurry; inconsiderate conduct, inconsiderateness.
चापाल: चापाल चापाल, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist Caitya.
चाबुका: चाबुका चाबुका, f. a small circular pillow.

चामरिक: चामरिक, अस्, m. a person who carries a Cāmara.
चामरिन्: चामरिन्, ई, m. a horse (either from his bushy tail which he uses to whisk off flies or from his having a Cāmara as his crest; see above).
चामीकर: चामीकर चामीकर, अम्, n. gold; the thorn-apple. —चामीकर-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, like gold.
चामुण्डा: चामुण्डा चामुण्डा, f. a form of Durgā; one of the seven Mātṛs; (अस्), m., N. of an author.
चाम्पेय: चाम्पेय चाम्पेय, अस्, m. (fr. चम्पा), N. of two trees, Michelia Champaka and Mesua Ferrea; a stamen or filament, especially of the lotus flower; a prince of Campā; N. of a son of Viśvā-mitra; (अस्, अम्), m. n. gold.
चाम्पेयक: चाम्पेयक, अम्, n. a stamen or filament.
चाम्य: चाम्य चाम्य, अम्, n. (fr. rt. चम्), food.
चाय्: चाय् चाय्, cl. 1. P. A. चायति, -ते, to ob-serve, discern, perceive; to worship, re-vere; [cf. 4. चि।]
चायमान: चायमान, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic of Abhyā-vartin.
चायितृ: चायितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. observing, seeing.
चायु: चायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. showing respect or reverence, honouring.
चारक: चारक, अस्, इका, अम्, acting, setting to work, proceeding; composed by Caraka; (अस्), m. a spy, a secret agent or emissary; a driver, a herdsman, a leader; an associate, a companion; a groom, a horseman, a cavalier; a wandering Brāhmanical stu-dent; a fetter, a bond, a prison; the plant Bucha-nania Latifolia (= चार); N. of a man; (इका), f. a female attendant; a cock-roach. —चारक-त्रिरात्र, अस्, m., N. of a festival.
चारकीण: चारकीण, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for a wandering Brāh-manical student.
चारण: चारण, अस्, m. a wanderer, a pilgrim; a wandering actor or singer, an actor of note, a dancer, a mime, a bard, a herald; a celestial singer, a panegyrist of the gods; a reader of scripture; a spy; N. of a place. —चारण-त्व, अम्, n. dancing (the art). —चारण-दारा, आस्, f. pl. female dancers, actresses, &c. —चारण-विद्य or चारण-वैद्य or चारणा-विद्य, आस्, m. pl., N. of a branch of the Atharva-veda.
चारथ: चारथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going, wandering or moving about, going in a carriage.

चारायण: चारायण, अस्, ई, m. f. a patronymic from Cara; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the Sādhāraṇādhi-karaṇa.
चारायणक: चारायणक, अस्, इका, अम्, derived from the Cārāyaṇas.
चारायणीय: चारायणीय, आस्, m. pl. the pupils of Cārāyaṇa.
चारित: चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to go; distilled, &c.
चारितार्थ्य: चारितार्थ्य, अम्, n. (fr. चरितार्थ), attainment of an object.

चारित्र्य: चारित्र्य, अम्, n. becoming or honourable practices, moral conduct, instituted observance.

चारटिका: चारटिका चारटिका, f. a kind of perfume, = नली।
चारटी: चारटी चारटी, f., N. of two plants, = पद्-म-चारिणी an भूम्य्-आमली।
चारभट: चारभट चारभट, अस्, m. a courageous man, a hero, a chief, a warrior; (ई), f. courage; [cf. आरभट।]
चारिवाच्: चारिवाच् चारिवाच्, क्, f., N. of a plant, = कर्कट-शृङ्गी।

Eng. fair; Brit. kaer.] —चारु-कर्ण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having beautiful ears. —चारु-केशरा, f. a kind of grass, Cyperus, = नागर-मुस्ता; a kind of tree, = तरुणी. —चारु-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa and Ruk-miṇī. —चारु-गीति, इस्, f. a kind of metre, a sort of Gīti, containing 29+32 syllabic instants. —चारु-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī. —चारु-घोण, अस्, आ, अम्, handsome-nosed. —चारु-चित्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —चारु-ता, f. or चारु-त्व, अम्, n. loveliness, beauty. —चारु-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —चारुदत्त-ना-मन्, आ, m. named Cāru-datta. —चारु-दन्त, अस्, m. ‘having beautiful teeth,’ N. of a merchant's son. —चारु-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, good-looking. —चारु-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man. —चारु-देष्ण, अस्, m., N. of a son of Gaṇḍūṣa; also of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Rukmiṇī. —चारु-धामन्, आ, m., N. of a plant. —चारु-धामा or चारु-धारा, f. an epithet of Śacī, the wife of Indra. —चारु-धिष्ण्य, अस्, m., N. of one of the Saptarṣayas in the eleventh Man-vantara. —चारु-नालक, अम्, n. a kind of lotus with red flowers. —चारु-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having beautiful eyes; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras. —चारु-पद, अस्, m., N. of a son of Namasyu. —चारु-पर्णी, f., N. of a plant, = प्र-सारणी. —चारु-पुट, अस्, m. a particular time in music. —चारु-प्रतीक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of lovely appearance. —चारु-फला, f. a vine, a grape. —चारु-बाहु, उस्, or चारु-भद्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Rukmiṇī. —चारु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, lovely, beautiful; (आन्), m., N. of a Cakra-vartin; (ती), f., N. of a daughter of Kṛṣṇa by Rukmiṇī. —चारु-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, handsome-faced, fair, beauteous; (ई), f., N. of a metre consisting of four lines of ten syllables each. —चारु-यशस्, आस्, m. ‘of fair fame,’ N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Rukmiṇī; [cf. चारु।] —चारु-रथ, अस् or अम्, m. or n. चार्चिक्य: चार्चिक्य, अम्, n. perfuming the person, smearing it with sandal &c.; unguent; [cf. चर्चिक्य।]
चार्म: चार्म चार्म, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चर्मन्), made of hide or leather, leathern; covered with leather (as a car &c.); defended by a hide or skin; shielded, having a shield.

चार्मिक: चार्मिक, अस्, ई, अम्, leather, made of leather, be-longing to the skin &c.

चार्मिण: चार्मिण, अम्, n. a number of men armed with shields.

2. चार्य, अम्, n. (fr. चर or चार), spying out, espionage, information brought by spies.
चार्वाक: चार्वाक चार्वाक, अस्, m. (fr. चारु + वाक), N. of a Rākṣasa described in the Mahā-bh. Śānti-parva 1414, &c., as a friend of Duryodhana and an enemy of the Pāṇḍavas; (having taken the shape of a mendicant Brāhman, when Yudhiṣṭhira entered Hāstina-pura in triumph, he reviled him and the assembled Brāhmans, but was soon detected; and the real Brāhmans, filled with fury, killed him on the spot); N. of a sophistical philosopher who probably lived before the composition of the Rāmāyaṇa; see जावालि। He was a sceptic in matters of Hindū faith, and considered by the orthodox as an atheist or materialist; according to some, the sceptical doctrines of the Indian materialists were handed down to Cārvāka and his followers by Vācas-pati or Bṛhaspati, and the aphorisms of Bṛhaspati (Bārhaspatya sūtras) are said to embody their opinions; (अस्, ई, अम्), derived from or composed by Cārvāka. —चार्वाक-दर्शन, अम्, n. the doctrine of Cārvāka.

चि: चि 1. चि, cl. 5. P. A. चिनोति, -नुते, चिकाय and चिचाय, चिक्ये and चिच्ये, चेष्यति, -ते, अचैषीत्, चेतुम्, to arrange in order, place in a line, heap up, pile up, construct (as a sacrificial altar, used in P. if the priests construct the altar for another, in A. if the sacrificer builds it for himself); to collect, gather together, accumulate, gain for one's self; to cover, inlay, set with (with inst., e. g. रत्नैः, with jewels): Caus. चाययति or चापयति, or चययति or चपयति: Desid. चिकीषति, and चिचीषति, to wish to pile up: Caus. of the Desid. चिचीषयति, to cause a person to wish to arrange in order or pile up: Intens. चेचीयते; [cf. Cambro-Brit. cai, ‘collection;’ Lat. cumulus; Pol. kupa; Germ. Haufen.]

चि 2. चि, cl. 3. P., Ved. चिकेति, Impf. अचिकेत्, Impv. 2nd sing. चिकीहि, चिकाय; cl. 5. P. A. चिनोति, चिनुते &c. like 1. चि, to observe, per-ceive; to fix the gaze upon; to be intent upon; to seek for, investigate; to make inquiries, search through.
चि 3. चि, cl. 1. A., Ved. चयते, to detest, hate; to revenge, punish, take vengeance on.
चि 4. चि, cl. 1. P. A. चायति, -ते, to fear, be afraid of (with acc.); to respect, honour; to observe; [cf. चाय्।]
चयन: चयन, अम्, n. the act of collecting, gathering, heaping up, aggregation; stacking wood; stacked wood; [cf. अग्नि-चयन।]
चयनीय: चयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be collected or gathered, to be heaped up.
चिचीषत्: चिचीषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to gather or collect.
चिचीषत् चिचीषत्। See under 1. चि, col. 1.
चित्: 1. चित्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of compounds) piling up (e. g. अग्नि-चित्, q. v.); forming a layer or stratum, piled up.
2. चित्, त्, त्, त्, observing, knowing (in ऋत-चित्).
3. चित्, त्, त्, त्, punishing (in ऋण-चित्).
चित् 1. 2. 3. चित्। See under rt. 1. 2. 3. चि।

चित् 4. चित् (= कित्, which is by some regarded as a separate root; cf. केत, &c.; cf. also rt. चिन्त्), cl. 1. 3. P. चेतति, चिकेत्ति, चिचेत or चिकेत, चिकिते or चेकिते or चिचिते (Ved. 3rd pl. चि-कित्रे or चिकित्रिरे; Part. चिकितान or चेकितान), चेति-ष्यति, अचेतीत्; Leṭ, चिकेतति or चिकेतत्; चेत्तुम् or चेतितुम्, to perceive, fix the mind upon, attend to, be attentive, observe, notice, take notice of (with gen. or acc., e. g. यज्ञस्य or यज्ञं चेतति, he takes notice of the sacrifice); to aim at, intend, design (with dat., e. g. युधये चिकेतति, he intends fighting), to desire, long for (with acc.); to be anxious about, to care for; to resolve; to understand, com-prehend, know, make known; to recover conscious-ness, become conscious; P. and A. to become per-ceptible, to appear; to be regarded as: to be known; Pass. Aor. अचेति: Caus. P. A. चितयति Ved., and चेत-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, केतयति, -यितुम् (see केत, p. 252), to cause to attend, to make attentive, remind of; to cause to comprehend or understand, instruct, teach; to observe, perceive, be intent upon; to form an idea in the mind, be conscious of, understand, compre-hend, think, reflect upon; to form a conception, have a right notion; to appear, be conspicuous, shine: Desid. P. A चिचितिषति, चिचेतिषति, चिकित्-सति, -ते; Inf. चिकित्सितुम्, to intend, have in view, aim at, desire, long for; to care for, be anxious about; to treat medically, heal, cure, attend as a physician (in these senses the form चिकित्सति is usual); to wish to appear; to remove, destroy; to keep down, press down; to doubt: Caus. of the Desid. चिकित्सयति, to cure, to heal; Intens. चेचित्यते, चेचेत्ति; [cf. Lith. kettu.]

5. चित्, त्, f. thought, intelligence, intellect, under-standing, mind; the soul, heart. —चिच्-चन्द्रिका, f. title of a commentary on the Prabodha-candrodaya by Gaṇeśa. —चिच्-छक्ति (चित्+शक्ति), इस्, f. mental power, intellectual capacity. —चिच्-छुक (चित्-शु°), अस्, m., N. of a scholiast on the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa; (ई), f. or चित्-सुखी, f. the commentary written by this scholiast. —चित्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. the lord of thought. —चित्-प्रवृत्ति, इस्, f. thinking, reflection. —चित्-स्वरूप, अम्, n. pure intelligence, an epithet of the Supreme. —चिद्-अचिच्छक्ति-युक्त (-अचित्-श°), अस्, आ, अम्, having power over matter and spirit. —चिद्-अम्बर, अस्, m., N. of the author of a law-book. —चिद्-अस्थि-माला, f. title of a commen-tary on a grammatical work. —चिद्-आत्मक, अम्, n. consciousness, perception. —चिद्-आत्मन्, आ, m. the thinking principle, pure intelligence, spirit. —चिद्-उल्लास, अस्, आ, अम्, gladdening the mind or heart. —चिद्-गगन-चन्द्रिका, f. title of a literary work. —चिद्-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of intelligence; wise, intelligent, of liberal or expansive mind; amiable, good-hearted; (अम्), n. pure intelligence, the Supreme Being as identified with intellect or intelligence. —चिद्-विलास, अस्, m. a pupil of Śaṅ-karācārya. —चिन्-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, spiritual, ‘all intelligence,’ as an epithet of the Deity; (अम्), n. pure intelligence. —चिन्-मात्र, अम्, n. pure in-telligence.
चित् 6. चित्, an interjection. —चित्-कार, अस्, m. or चित्कार-शब्द, अस्, m. a cry, scream, bray. —चित्कार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accompanied by cries or noise.
चित् 7. चित्, ind. a particle, = चिद् below.
चित: चित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled, heaped; collected, gathered, accumulated; covered, veiled, concealed; (आ), f. a layer, a pile of wood, a funeral pile, pyre; a heap, an assemblage, a multitude; (अम्), n. a building (e. g. पक्वेष्टक-चित, a building of burnt bricks). —चित-विस्तर, अस्, m. a kind of ornament. —चिताग्नि (°त-अग्°), इस्, m. the funeral fire. —चिता-चूडक, अम्, n. a mark where a funeral pile has been, a mausoleum, a monument, &c. —चितैध (°त-एध), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging or referring to a funeral pile.
चिति: 1. चिति, इस्, f. a stratum, layer of wood or bricks &c.; a pile, a stack; a funeral pile; an oblong with quadrangular sides; collecting, gathering; a heap, a quantity, a multitude; N. of the eighth or tenth book of the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa; [cf. अमृत-चिति।] —चिति-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a funeral pile.
चिति, इस्, f., Ved. gathering, collecting.
2. चिति, इस्, f. understanding; (इस्), m. the thinking mind.
चितिका: चितिका, f. a stack, a pile; a funeral pile; a small chain worn as an ornament round the loins, a kind of girdle.
चितीक: चितीक (at the end of an adj. comp. after a numeral) = चिति, a layer (e. g. पञ्च-चितीक, त्रि-च्°, एक-च्°).
चित्य: चित्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be arranged in order or built up; (scil. अग्नि, fire), placed or constructed upon a foundation or basis (as of stones &c.); (आ), f. piling up, building (an altar &c.); a funeral pile; (अम्), n. the place at which a corpse has been burnt and where a monument has been erected; a monument or any mark of the site of a funeral pile. —चित्याधिरोहण (°य-अध्°), अम्, n. burning with a husband's corpse. —चित्यारोहण (°य-आर्°), अम्, n. ascending the funeral pile.
चिन्वत्: 1. चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, gathering, collecting.
2. चिन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seeking for, searching for.
चेतव्य: चेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be collected or gathered, to be piled up.
चेय: चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be piled up, to be gathered or collected.
चेय चेय। See 1. चि, p. 322, col. 2.
चेतृ: 1. चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, an observer, guardian.
2. चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a revenger.
चेतृ चेतृ, चेत्या। See 2. and 3. चि, p. 322.
चिकरिषु: चिकरिषु चिकरिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. 1. कॄ), desirous to cast or throw, wishing to pour out.
चिकर्तिषु: चिकर्तिषु चिकर्तिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. 2. कृत्), desirous or intending to cut or cut off.
चिकित्: चिकित् चिकित्, चिकिति, &c. See p. 323, col. 1.
चिकित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. understanding, knowing, ex-perienced.
चिकिन: चिकिन चिकिन, अस्, आ, अम्, flat-nosed; (अम्), n. flat-nosedness; [cf. चिक्क and चिपिट।]
चिकिल: चिकिल चिकिल, अस्, m. mud, mire, a slough, a bog; [cf. इचिकिल and चिखल्ल।]
चिकीर्षक: चिकीर्षक चिकीर्षक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Desid. of rt. 1. कृ), desirous of doing, meaning to do.
चिकीर्षत्: चिकीर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing or purposing to act or do.
चिकीर्षा: चिकीर्षा, f. intention or desire to act, wish, will, design, purpose, desire of doing or performing any-thing.
चिकीर्षित: चिकीर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, intended to be done; wished, designed, purposed; (अम्), n. purpose, design, in-tention.
चिकीर्षु: चिकीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to act, desiring or intending to do or make or perform anything; wishing to practice; desirous for.
चिकीर्ष्य: चिकीर्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished to be done, to be designed.
चिकुर: चिकुर चिकुर, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps a redu-plicated form of rt. कॄ or of कर् for चर्), incon-siderate, rash, punishing or injuring others without consideration; (अस्), m. the hair of the head, a lock of hair; a mountain; a kind of tree or plant; a snake, N. of a Nāga; a kind of bird; a musk-rat; [cf. चिक्क and चिक्किर; cf. also Gr. κίκιννος; Lat. cincinnus ?]. —चिकुर-कलाप or चिकुर-पक्ष or चिकुर-पाश or चिकुर-भार, अस्, m. or चिकुर-रचना, f. or चिकुर-हस्त or चिकुरोच्चय (°र-उच्°), अस्, m. a mass of hair, a tuft of hair.
चिकूर: चिकूर, अस्, m. the hair, = चिकुर।
चिक्क्: चिक्क् चिक्क्, cl. 10. P. चिक्कयति, -यितुम्, to feel pain; to give or inflict pain; [cf. चक्क् and चुक्क्।]
चिक्क: चिक्क चिक्क, अस्, आ, अम्, flat-nosed; (अम्), n. flat-nosedness; (अस्), m. the musk-rat; (according to other authorities चिक; cf. चिकुर and चिक्किर); (आ), f. a mouse; a betel-nut; [cf. चिक्कण।]
चिक्कण: चिक्कण चिक्कण, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 4. चित्), smooth, glossy; slippery; bland, emollient; unctuous, greasy; (अस्), m. the betel-nut tree; (अम्, आ or ई), n. f. the betel-nut; (आ), f. an excellent cow; (other authorities have चिक्किणा।) —चिक्कण-कन्थ, अम्, n., N. of a town; [cf. चित्कण-कन्थ and चिहण-कन्थ।] —चिक्कण-ता, f. or चिक्-कण-त्व, अम्, n. smoothness, oiliness, greasiness, unctuousness.
चिक्कस: चिक्कस चिक्कस, अस्, अम्, m. n. barley-meal.
चिक्किण: चिक्किण चिक्किण, अस्, आ, अम्, glossy, shining, smooth; slippery; bland, emollient; unctuous, greasy; (आ), f. an excellent cow.
चिक्किर: चिक्किर चिक्किर, अस्, m. a small venomous animal (मूषिक); [cf. चिकुर, चिक्क, छिक्कर।]
चिक्रंसा: चिक्रंसा चिक्रंसा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. क्रम्), a wish to go, desire of approaching.
चिक्रीडिषा: चिक्रीडिषा चिक्रीडिषा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. क्रीड्), a wish or desire to play.
चिक्लिद: चिक्लिद चिक्लिद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. क्लिद्), the moon; (अम्), n. moisture, freshness; [cf. क्लेदु।]
चिखल्ल: चिखल्ल चिखल्ल, अस्, m. mud, mire, a slough; [cf. इचिकिल and चिकिल।]
चिखादिषु: चिखादिषु चिखादिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. खाद्), wishing or desiring to eat.
चिङ्गट: चिङ्गट चिङ्गट, अस्, ई, m. f. or चिङ्गड, अस्, m. a shrimp or prawn; [cf. उच्चिङ्गट।]
चिचिण्ड: चिचिण्ड चिचिण्ड, अस्, m. a sort of gourd, Trichosanthes Anguina.
चिचीकुची: चिचीकुची चिचीकुची and चिचीकूची। See चीचीकूची।
चिच्चिटिङ्ग: चिच्चिटिङ्ग चिच्चिटिङ्ग, अस्, m. a species of venomous insect; [cf. उच्चिटिङ्ग।]
चिच्छित्सु: चिच्छित्सु चिच्छित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. छिद्), wishing or intending to cut off.
चिच्छिल: चिच्छिल चिच्छिल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
चिञ्चा: चिञ्चा चिञ्चा, f. the tamarind tree or its fruit. —चिञ्चाम्ल (°चा-अम्°) or चिञ्चा-सार, अस्, m. an acid pot-herb, Rumex Vesicatorius.
चिञ्चाटक: चिञ्चाटक चिञ्चाटक, अस्, m. a various read-ing for चिञ्चोटक।
चिञ्चिनी: चिञ्चिनी चिञ्चिनी, f., N. of a town.
चिञ्ची: चिञ्ची चिञ्ची, f. the plant Abrus Preca-torius; [cf. काक-चिञ्चा।]
चिञ्चोटक: चिञ्चोटक चिञ्चोटक, अस्, m. a kind of plant, = अङ्कलोड्य or क्रौञ्चादन।
चिट्: चिट् चिट्, cl. 1. and 10. P. चेटति and चेट-यति, &c., to send out or forth (as a mes-senger), to give orders to a servant; to be a servant.
चेट: चेट, अस्, m. a servant, &c. See s. v.
चेट चेट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चिट्), a servant, a slave, (गर्भ-चेट, a slave by birth); (ई), f. a female servant or slave.
चिकित: चिकित, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf. चेकित।]
चिकितान: चिकितान, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf. चैकितानेय and चेकितान।]
चिकितायन: चिकितायन, अस्, m. a descendant of Cikita; [cf. चैकितायन।]
चिकिति: चिकिति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. knowing, acquainted with, experienced.
चिकितु: चिकितु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. understanding, knowing, experienced; (उस्), f. understanding, intellect.
चिकित्वन्: चिकित्वन्, आ, m., Ved. understanding, intellect.
चिकित्वस्: चिकित्वस्, वान्, उषी, वस्, one who has observed, observing, attending to, attentive, knowing, under-standing, experienced, conversant with.
चिकित्वित्: चिकित्वित्, ind., Ved. with intelligence, intelligently; with deliberation, deliberately; (Sāy.) making known (= ज्ञापयन्तीम् in Ṛg-veda IV. 52, 4). —चिकित्विन्-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. one whose mind is attentive; coming from an intelligent mind, well considered; (Sāy.) one who knows all hearts.
चिकित्सक: चिकित्सक, अस्, m. a physician, doctor, practiser in medicine.
चिकित्सन: चिकित्सन, अम्, n. healing, practising medicine, medical attendance.
चिकित्सा: चिकित्सा, f. the practice or science of medicine, healing, curing, administering or applying remedies; (in the system of medicine) one of the six sections, therapeutics. —चिकित्सा-कलिका, f. title of a medical work by Tīśaṭa. —चिकित्साकलिका-टीका, f. a com-mentary on the last work by Candraṭa. —चिकित्सा-कौमुदी, f. title of a medical work by Kāśī-rāja. —चिकित्सा-तत्त्व-ज्ञान, अम्, n. title of a medical work by Dhanvantari. —चिकित्सा-दर्पण, अम्, n. title of a medical work by Divodāsa.
चिकित्सित: चिकित्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, treated medically, remedied, healed, physicked, cured; (अम्), n. healing, reme-dying, medical attendance; pl. the chapters of the therapeutical section of medicine; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
चिकित्सु: चिकित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. wise, cunning.
चिकित्स्य: चिकित्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be treated medically, to be cured, curable.
चित्त: चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, perceived, observed, considered; reflected upon; resolved; intended, aimed at, under-stood; visible, perceptible; (अम्), n. attending, ob-serving; thinking, reflecting, imagining, thought; intention, aim, wish; the heart considered as the seat of intellect; the mind, the reasoning faculty; intellect, reason; reason personified; [cf. अ-चित्त, इह-च्°, चल-च्°, पूर्व-च्°, प्रायश्-च्°, &c.] —चित्त-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, anticipated, expected, calculated; known. —चित्त-गर्भा, f., Ved. visibly pregnant. —चित्त-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, proceeding or acting accord-ing to the wish of another (with gen.) —चित्त-जन्मन्, आ, m. produced within the mind, love, the god of love; [cf. चित्त-भू, चित्त-योनि, मनसि-ज।] —चित्त-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the hearts, heart-searching. —चित्तज्ञ-ता, f. knowledge of the heart. —चित्त-नाश, अस्, m. loss of conscience. —चित्त-निर्व्रित्ति, इस्, f. contentment of mind, happiness. —चित्त-प्रमाथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving or touching the heart, exciting passion or love, afflicting the mind. —चित्त-प्रशम, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied in mind, composed, complacent, tranquil, content. —चित्त-प्रसन्न-ता, f. happiness of the mind, gaiety, joy. —चित्त-प्र-सादन, अम्, n. gladdening of the mind. —चित्त-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the thoughts, felt, per-ceived. —चित्त-भेद, अस्, m. inconsistency, con-trariety of purpose or will. —चित्त-भू, ऊस्, m. love, the god of love. —चित्त-भ्रम-चिकित्सा, f. ‘medical treatment of mental derangement,’ a chapter of the medical work Vaidya-vallabha. —चित्त-मोह, अस्, m. confusion or infatuation of mind. —चित्त-योनि, इस्, m. love; see चित्त-जन्मन्. —चित्त-राग, अस्, m. affection, passion, desire. —चित्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, endowed with understanding, reasonable; kind-hearted, amiable. —चित्तवत्-कर्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, (a root) employing an intelligent agent (e. g. देव-दत्तः पचति, Deva-datta cooks). —चित्त-विकार, अस्, m. change of thoughts or feelings, disturbance of mind. —चित्त-विकारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, changing a person's character or feeling. —चित्त-विनाशन, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying the conscience. —चित्त-विप्लव, अस्, m. disturbance of mind, madness, insanity. —चित्त-विभ्रम, अस्, m. derangement of mind, madness. —चित्त-विश्लेष, अस्, m. parting of hearts, breach of friendship. —चित्त-वृत्ति, इस्, f. disposition of mind, feeling; inward purpose, emotion; thinking, imagining. —चित्त-वेदना, f. anxiety, affliction. —चित्त-वैकल्य, अम्, n. bewilderment of mind, distraction, perplexity. —चित्त-संहति, इस्, f. a multitude of thoughts or emotions, many minds. —चित्त-सङ्ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, pervading the heart, penetrating the soul, knowing the thoughts. —चित्त-समुन्नति, इस्, f. pride of heart, arrogance, hau-teur, haughtiness. —चित्त-स्थ or चित्त-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed in the mind, being in the heart; (अस्), m., N. of a Samādhi. —चित्त-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, stealing the heart, fascinating, agreeable, beautiful. —चित्त-हृत्, त्, त्, त्, fascinating, winning. —चित्ता-नुवर्तिन् (°त-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, gratifying wishes, humouring. —चित्तापहारक (°त-अप्°), अस्, इका, अम्, or चित्तापहारिन् (°त-अप्°), ई, इणी, इ, heart-stealing, captivating, attractive. —चित्ताभोग (°त-आभ्°), अस्, m. full consciousness, consciousness of pleasure or pain, the attention of the mind to its own sensations. —चित्तासङ्ग (°त-आस्°), अस्, m. attachment, affection, love. —चित्तैक्य (°त-ऐक्°), अम्, n. unanimity, harmony, agreement. —चित्तोन्-नति (°त-उन्°), इस्, f. pride of heart, arrogance.
चित्ति: 1. चित्ति, इस्, f. thinking, thought, reflection; under-standing, wisdom; thoughts, devotion (in pl.); inten-tion; a wise person; thought personified as the wife of Atharvan and mother of Dadhyac; [cf. अ-चित्ति, पूर्व-चित्ति, प्रायश्-चित्ति।]
चित्ति 2. चित्ति, इस्, f., Ved. (according to some commentaries) crackling, whizzing; (according to others) a sacrificial act; [cf. चित्-कार।]
चित्तिन्: चित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. intelligent, wise.
चित्तीकृ: चित्ती-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make anything an object of thought or reflection.
चित्तीकृत: चित्ती-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed in the mind.
चित्र: चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, perceptible, visible, conspicuous, excellent, distinguished; bright, clear, bright-coloured; variegated, spotted, speckled; rough, agitated (as the sea, opposed to सम); clear, loud, perceptible (as a sound); various, different, manifold; strange, wonderful, surprising, (किम् अत्र चित्रम्, what is there surprising in that? there is nothing strange in that); containing the word चित्र; (अस्), m. variety of colour; N. of several plants, viz. Plumbago Zey-lanica, Ricinus Communis, Jonesia Aśoka; a form of Yama; N. of a king; of a descendant of Gaṅga and of Gauśra; of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of a king of Draviḍa; (आ), f. Spica Virginis, a star in the virgin's spike, a constellation; (according to the more ancient reckoning the twelfth, according to the new the fourteenth lunar mansion); a kind of snake; N. of several plants, viz. Anthericum Tuberosum or Salvinia Cucculata, Cucumis Maderaspatanus, a kind of cucumber; also = दन्ती; Ricinus Communis; the Myrobalan tree; also = मृगेर्वारु and गण्ड-दूर्वा; Rubia Munjista; N. of a metre, a kind of Mātrāsamaka, containing 4 × 16 syllabic instants; another metre consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each; another metre consisting of four lines of sixteen syllables each; worldly illusion, unreality; N. of an Apsaras; also of a sister of Kṛṣṇa and wife of Arjuṇa, = सु-भद्रा; also of a daughter of Gada, or (according to a various reading) of Kṛṣṇa; also of a river; (अम्), n. anything bright or coloured which strikes the eyes; a brilliant ornament, an ornament; a bright or extraordinary appearance, a wonder; the ether, sky, heaven; a spot; a circular ornament, a sectarial mark on the forehead; white or spotted leprosy; a picture, painting, sketch, de-lineation: variety of colour; various modes of writing or arranging verses in the shape of mathematical or other fanciful figures, (this is done either by leaving out syllables which occur repeatedly, or by represent-ing words in a shortened form); playing upon words, punning in the form of question and answer, facetious conversation, conundrums, riddles, &c.; [cf. अ-चित्र, दानु-च्°, वि-च्°, चैत्र; cf. also Lith. kytras.] —चित्र-कण्ठ, अस्, m. ‘having a speckled throat,’ a pigeon. —चित्र-कथालाप-सुख (°था-आल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, happy in telling charming stories. —चित्र-कम्बल, अस्, m. a variegated carpet; a painted cloth used as an elephant's housing. —चित्र-कर, अस्, m. a painter; [cf. चित्र-कार and चित्र-कृत्।] —चित्र-कर्ण, अस्, m. ‘strange-ear,’ N. of a camel. —चित्र-कर्मन्, अ, n. any extraordinary act, a wonderful deed; magic; ornamenting, decorating; painting, a paint-ing, picture; (आ), m. working wonders, a magician; a painter; the tree Dalbergia Ougeinensis; [cf. चित्र-कृत्।] —चित्रकर्म-विद्, त्, m. skilled in the art of painting; a painter, a magician. —चित्र-काय, अस्, m. ‘having a striped or speckled body,’ a tiger, a leopard, panther. —चित्र-कार, अस्, m. a painter; [cf. चित्र-कर।] —चित्र-कुण्डल, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —चित्र-कूट, अस्, m. ‘wonderful peak,’ N. of a hill and district, the modern Chitrakote or Chatarcot (near Kampta), situated on the river Pai-suni (Piśunī) about fifty miles S. E. of the town of Bandah in Bundelkhund, lat. 25. 12, long. 80. 47. It was the first habitation of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa in their exile after leaving Ayodhyā, and as the holiest spot of the worshippers of Rāma is crowded with temples and shrines; N. of a town. —चित्र-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, astonishing, surprising; (त्), m. a painter; the tree Dalbergia Ougeinensis; [cf. चित्र-कर्मन्।] —चित्र-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Garuḍa; also of Vasiṣṭha; also of Lakṣmaṇa; also of Deva-bhāga; also of a king of the Śūra-senas. —चित्र-कोल, अस्, m. a kind of lizard. —चित्र-क्रिया, f. painting. —चित्र-क्षत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose do-minion is brilliant (as Agni); (Sāy.) having various power or one whose wealth is visible. —चित्र-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, represented in a picture, painted. —चित्र-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, coloured, variegated; represented in a picture, painted, delineated. —चित्र-गन्ध, अम्, n. yellow orpiment. —चित्र-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of one of the beings recording the vices and virtues of mankind in Yama's world; N. of a mixed caste, a secretary or writer of a man of rank; a form of Yama; N. of the sixteenth Arhat of the future Utsarpiṇī. —चित्र-गृह, अस्, m. a painted room, or one ornamented with pictures; [cf. चित्र-शाला।] —चित्र-गो, औस्, औस्, उ, having a brindled cow. —चित्र-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘speckled-neck,’ N. of a pigeon-king. —चित्र-चाप, अस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —चित्र-जल्प, अस्, m. talking on various things, talking incoherently. —चित्र-तण्डुल, अम्, आ, n. f. a medicinal plant said to possess anthelmintic virtues; [cf. विड्-अङ्ग।] —चित्र-तल, अस्, आ, अम्, painted or variegated on the surface. —चित्र-त्वच्, क्, m. ‘having curious bark,’ the birch or bhūrja tree. —चित्र-दण्डक, अस्, m. the cotton plant, Arum Campanulatum; [cf. ओल।] —चित्र-दर्शन, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman changed into a bird (‘having varie-gated eyes’). —चित्र-दीप, अस्, m. title of a philo-sophical work. —चित्र-दृशीक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. looking brilliant or shining. —चित्र-देव, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; (ई), f., N. of a plant, = महेन्द्र-वारुणी. —चित्र-धर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince identified with the Asura Virū-pākṣa. —चित्र-धा, ind. in a manifold way. —चित्र-ध्रजति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. making a bright line, an epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) having a wonderful course. —चित्र-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of a man. —चित्र-नेत्रा, f. a small bird called Maina, = सारिका; [cf. चित्र-लोचना and चित्राक्षी।] —चित्र-न्यस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, represented in a picture, painted. —चित्र-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having variegated wings; (अस्), m. the francoline partridge; N. of a demon causing head-ache. —चित्र-पट or चित्र-पट्ट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a painting, a picture. —चित्र-पट्ट-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘committed to a picture,’ painted. —चित्र-पत्त्रिका, f., N. of a plant, = कपित्थ-पर्णी and द्रोण-पुष्पी. —चित्र-पत्त्री, f., N. of an aquatic plant; [cf. जल-पिप्पली।] —चित्र-पद, अस्, आ, अम्, divided into various parts; full of graceful words or expressions; (आ), f., N. of the plant Cissus Pedata [cf. गोधापदी]; N. of a metre con-sisting of four lines of eight syllables each; (अम्), n., N. of a metre consisting of four lines of twenty-three syllables each. —चित्रपद-क्रमम्, ind. at a good or brisk pace. —चित्र-पर्णिका, f., N. of a plant, commonly Cākulīya, Hemionites Cordifolia; Bengal madder, Rubia Munjista, = अति-गुहा, घृष्-ठिला, त्रि-पर्णी, दीर्घ-पत्त्रा, &c. —चित्र-पर्णी, f., N. of several plants, = पृश्नि-पर्णी, कर्ण-स्फोटा, जल-पिप्पली, द्रोण-पुष्पी; also = Rubia Munjista. —चित्र-पाटल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a plant. —चित्र-पादा, f. a small bird com-monly called Maina; [cf. सारिका।] —चित्र-पिच्छक, अस्, m. ‘having a variegated tail,’ a peacock. —चित्र-पुङ्ख, अस्, m. ‘having variegated feathers,’ an arrow. —चित्र-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —चित्र-पुष्पी, f., N. of a shrub, = अम्बष्ठा. —चित्र-पृष्ठ, अस्, m. ‘speckled-back,’ a sparrow. —चित्र-प्रतिकृति, इस्, f. a representation in colours, a paint-ing, a picture. —चित्र-प्रिय-कथ, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking very kindly. —चित्र-फल, अस्, m. a kind of fish, commonly Chitala, Mystus Chitala; a kind of cucumber, Cucumis Sativus; (आ), f. a kind of fish, commonly Phalaï, = फलकिन्, महोन्मद, राज-ग्रीव, Mystus Karpirat; N. of several plants, = चिर्भिटा, मृगेर्वारु, महेन्द्र-वारुणी, वार्ताकी, कण्टकारी; (ई), f. the above fish. —चित्र-फ-लक, अम्, n. a tablet for painting, a picture, a painting; (अस्), m. a kind of fish; see above. —चित्र-बर्ह, अस्, m. ‘having a variegated tail,’ a peacock; N. of a son of Garuḍa. —चित्र-बर्हिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a variegated tail. —चित्र-बर्हिस्, इस्, इस्, इस्, Ved. having a brilliant or shining litter (i. e. bed of stars), an epithet of Pūṣan and the moon; (Sāy.) strewed with various grasses (as the ground). —चित्र-बाहु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —चित्र-भानु, उस्, उस्, उ, of varie-gated lustre, shining with light; epithet of Agni, Savitṛ, the Aśvins, &c.; (उस्), m. a N. of fire; of Śiva; the plant Plumbago Zeylanica; the sun; N. of the Calotropis Gigantea (= अर्क); the first year of the first cycle of Jupiter; an epithet of Bhairava, a form of Śiva; N. of the father of Vāṇa-bhaṭṭa, the author of the Kādambarī. —चित्र-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, made into a picture, painted. —चित्र-भेषजा, f. the tree Ficus Oppositifolia; [cf. काकोडुम्बर।] —चित्र-मण्डल, अस्, m. a kind of snake. —चित्र-महस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having extraordinary abundance; (Sāy.) having conspicuous brightness or splendor. —चित्र-मृग, अस्, m. the spotted antelope. —चित्र-मेखल, अस्, m. ‘girdled with spots,’ a peacock. —चित्र-यज्ञ, अस्, m. title of a comedy by Vaidya-nātha. —चित्र-यान, अस्, m., N. of a prince. —चित्र-याम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a splendid or brilliant course (as Agni). —चित्र-योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting in a wonderful manner or in various ways; (ई), m. an epithet of Arjuna; the tree Terminalia Arjuna. —चित्र-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bright or splen-did chariot (as Agni); (अस्), m. ‘having a variegated car,’ the sun; the king of the Gandharvas; N. of a snake-demon; of a Vidyā-dhara; of a son of Gada or (according to a various reading) of Kṛṣṇa; of a king; of a king of the Aṅgas; of a descendant of Aṅga and son of Dharma-ratha; of a son of Ushadgu; of Vṛṣṇi; of Gaya; of Su-pārśvaka; of Ukta; of a prince of Mṛttikāvatī; of a Sūta; and of others; (आ), f., N. of a river; [cf. चैत्ररथ।] —चित्र-रश्मि, इस्, m., N. of a Marut (‘having variegated rays’). —चित्र-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. granting wonderful or excellent gifts, epithet of the Aśvins. —चित्र-राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. bestowing excellent favour; (Sāy.) having wonderful wealth. —चित्र-रेफ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Medhātithi, king of Śāka-dvīpa. —चित्र-लता, f. the plant Rubia Munjista; [cf. चित्र-पर्णी।] —चित्र-लिखन, अम्, n. ‘variegated drawing,’ paining. —चित्र-लिखित, अस्, आ, अम्, repre-sented, delineated (as in a picture), painted; motion-less, dumb (as a picture or statue). —चित्र-लेखक, अस्, m. a painter. —चित्र-लेखनिका, f. a painter's brush. —चित्र-लेखा, f. a picture, a portrait; N. of a metre of four lines of seventeen syllables each; another metre of the same sort; N. of a metre of four lines of eighteen syllables each; N. of an Apsaras born from Brahmā's hand, (she was a friend of Ūṣā and skilful in painting); N. of a daughter of Kum-bhāṇḍa, minister of king Vāṇa, also a friend of Ūṣā. —चित्रलेखा-द्वितीया, f. having Citralekhā as a second, accompanied by Citralekhā. —चित्र-लोचना, f. ‘having variegated eyes,’ a small bird, commonly called Maina, = सारिका; [cf. चित्र-नेत्रा and चित्राक्षी।] —चित्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, decorated with paintings or ornaments; containing the word चित्र; (ती), f., N. of a metre of four lines of thirteen syllables each; N. of a daughter of Gada or (accord-ing to others) of Kṛṣṇa. —चित्र-वदाल, अस्, m. the sheat-fish, Silurus Pelorius, = पाठीन. —चित्र-वन, अम्, n. wonderful wood,’ N. of a wood near the Gaṇḍakī; [cf. चित्रक।] —चित्र-वर्मन्, आ, m. ‘having variegated arrows,’ N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; also of a king of the Kulūtas; N. of a king of Mathura and Campāvatī. —चित्र-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining in an unusual manner. —चित्र-वल्लिक, अस्, m. a kind of sheat-fish, Silurus Boalis; चिद्: चिद् चिद्, ind. [cf. 2. च and इद्], an enclitic particle, requiring in the Veda a preceding simple verb to retain its accent. In the Pada-pāṭha चिद् is considered as an independent word (कश् चिद् &c. being always separated into two words). In later Sanskrit it is generally a particle affixed to interroga-tive pronouns to render them indefinite. The use of चिद् in Vedic Sanskrit is principally to lay stress or emphasis on a preceding word or to extend or limit the sense. Hence it is often translateable by ‘even,’ ‘indeed,’ ‘also,’ ‘at least,’ ‘just,’ ‘merely,’ &c. (e. g. देवाश् चिद्, the gods indeed; एकस्य चिद्, of one merely); or when preceded by a negative particle by ‘not even’ (e. g. न देवाश् चिद्, not even the gods): but its force may often be expressed by merely laying an emphasis on the word by which it is preceded. Hence in Nirukta I. 4. it is said to be used पूजायाम्, i. e. for enhancing the force of a word. It is also stated by Yāska to be a particle of comparison (उपमार्थे). The following Vedic uses of चिद् may be noted; यच् चिद्, यथा चिद्, = when indeed, as indeed; चिद् — चिद् or चिद् — च or चिद् — उ, = as well as — as; both — and.

चिद् is often joined to interrogative pronouns and adverbs (see 2. क, कतम, कतर, कद्, किम्, कथम्, कदा, कुतस्, क्व, &c.) to render them indefinite; especially in classical Sanskrit, where the only other word after which it is found is जातु, q. v.

Any of the oblique cases sing. of चिर may be used adverbially, e. g. चिरम् or चिरेण or चिराय or चिरात् or चिरस्य or चिरे, = long, for a long time, after a long time, a long while ago, long since; at last, finally, too late. चिर is also used adverbially at the beginning of comp. as in some of the following examples; [cf. Hib. sir, ‘long.’] —चिर-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, or चिर-कारि, इस्, इस्, इ, or चिर-कारिक, अस्, आ, अम्, or चिर-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, working or acting slowly, dilatory, delaying. —चिर-कारि-ता, f. or चिरकारि-त्व, अम्, n. dilatoriness, slowness. —चिर-काल, अस्, m. a long period; चोदयत्: चोदयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, impelling, animating, in-spiring. —चोदयन्-मति (°यत्-म°), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. inspiring, promoting piety or devotion; (Sāy.) whose mind is inspiring.
चोदयितृ: चोदयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, driving, impelling, ani-mating, promoting.
चोदस्: चोदस्, अस्, n. = चोदन। See अ-चोदस्।
चोदित: चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged; ordered, directed; thrown, cast; appointed; informed, ap-prised.
चोदितृ: चोदितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, driving, impelling, animating, promoting.
चोदिष्ठ: चोदिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of preceding), Ved. impelling or animating much.
चोद्य: चोद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be driven or impelled; to be sent, thrown or directed; to be mentioned or com-municated; (अम्), n. raising a question, objecting, asking a question; surprise, astonishment, wonder.
चोद्यमान: चोद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being urged or driven.

चुप्: चुप् 1. चुप्, cl. 1. P. चोपति, चुचोप, चोपि-ष्यति, चोपितुम्, to move, stir; to move slowly, creep or steal along; [cf. Lith. kopu; Germ. hüpfen; Eng. hop.]
चुप् 2. चुप् (a various reading for छुप्), cl. 6. P. चुपति, to touch.
चोपक: चोपक चोपक। See 1. चुप्, p. 328, col. 1.

चुब्र: चुब्र चुब्र, अम्, n. (fr. 1. चुम्ब् ?), the face, the mouth.

चौरिका: चौरिका, f. (fr. चोर or चौर), thievery, theft, robbing.

चुरी: चुरी चुरी, f. a small well.
चुल्: चुल् चुल्, cl. 10. P. चोलयति, -यितुम्, to raise, elevate; to rise, increase; to dip, dive into; [cf. बुल्।]
चुलका: चुलका चुलका, f., N. of a river; (also read चुलुका।)
चुलुक: चुलुक चुलुक, अस्, m. deep mud or mire; a mouthful of water, the hand hollowed to hold water; a small vessel or pot, a gallipot &c.; N. of a man; (आ), f. = चुलका; (अम्), n. water in which pulse has been steeped; [cf. चलुक।]
चुलुकिन्: चुलुकिन्, ई, m. a porpoise, sea-hog, or similar animal; [cf. उलुपिन्, चुल्लकी, चुलुम्पिन्।]
चुलुम्प्: चुलुम्प् चुलुम्प्, cl. 1. P. चुलुम्पति, &c., to swing, rock; to cut (?), to dis-appear, to be lost (?).
चुलुम्प: चुलुम्प, अस्, m. fondling or nursing children; (आ), f. a she-goat.
चुलुम्पिन्: चुलुम्पिन् or चुलूपिन्, ई, m. = चुलुकिन्, a Gangetic porpoise, sea-hog, or similar animal.
चुल्ल्: चुल्ल् चुल्ल्, cl. 1. P. चुल्लति, &c., to play, sport, dally, wanton, coquet; to con-jecture; manifest one's meaning (?).
चुल्ल: चुल्ल चुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, blear-eyed; (अस्), m. a blear eye; [cf. चिल्ल and पिल्ल।]
चुल्लक: चुल्लक चुल्लक, अस्, m. (for चुलुक), the palm of the hand hollowed as if to hold water.
चुल्लकी: चुल्लकी, f. a kind of water-pot; a porpoise, sea-hog [cf. चुलुकिन्]; N. of a family; a sort of tribe or caste (?); the opposite bank of a river (?).
चुल्लि: चुल्लि चुल्लि, इस्, f. a fire-place, chimney.
चुल्ली: चुल्ली, f. a fire-place, chimney; a funeral pile; a large apartment or hall composed of three wings or divisions, one looking north, another east, and the third west.
चुश्च्यूषा: चुश्च्यूषा चुश्च्यूषा, f. (fr. चूष्), sucking, sucking out.
चुस्त: चुस्त चुस्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. the burnt ex-terior of roast meat; fried meat; chaff; rind.
चूचुक: चूचुक चुचुक, अम्, n. (perhaps a redupli-cated form of rt. चूष् or fr. चूचु, imitative noise in sucking &c.), the nipple of the breast; (अस्, आ, अम्), stammering, a stammerer; [cf. चुचुक; cf. also Hib. cioch, ‘the breast,’ and Gr. θηλή, τίτθη, τιτθός; Germ. zitze in relation to rt. धे, ‘to drink,’ and Lat. papilla in relation to rt. पा।]
चूड: चूड चूड, अस्, m. a sort of knob or pro-tuberance on a sacrificial brick (Ved.); the ceremony of tonsure as performed on a child; N. of a man with the patronymic Bhāgavitti; (आ), f. the hair on the top of the head, a single lock or tuft of hair left on the crown of the head after the ceremony of tonsure, a top-knot; the ceremony of tonsure (see चूडा-करण); the crest of a cock or peacock; any crest, plume, diadem, &c.; the head; top, summit; an upper room, a room on the top of a house &c.; a kind of bracelet; a small well; a kind of metre; N. of a woman; [cf. चूल, चोड, चौल, उच्-चूड, ताम्र-चूड, पञ्च-चूडा; cf. also कूट and Hib. cuit, ‘the head.’] —चूडा-करण, अम्, n. ‘forming the crest,’ i. e. shaving the head all but one lock, considered as a religious and purificatory rite; it should be performed in the first or third year; [cf. चौल।] —चूडा-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a mendicant. —चूडा-कर्मन्, अ, n. the ceremony of forming the crest, the rite of tonsure; [cf. चूडा-करण।] —चूडा-पक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a man (?). —चूडा-प्रतिग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a Caitya. —चूडा-मणि, इस्, m. a jewel worn by men and women on the top of the head; a jewel worn in a crest or diadem; (often at the end of a comp.) the best or most ex-cellent of a class, ‘the gem’ (e. g. आचार्य-चक्र-चूडामणि, ‘the best of the whole circle of Ācāryas,’ an epithet of Vopa-deva; पण्डित-चूडामणि, a chief among scholars); the seed of the Abrus Preca-torius [cf. गुञ्जा]; title of an astronomical work; title of a work on music. —चूडामणि-धर, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-demon. —चूडा-रत्न, अम्, n. a jewel worn by men and women on the top of the head; [cf. चूडा-मणि।] —चूडा-लक्षण, अम्, n. tonsure. —चूडा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a single lock of hair or tuft on the top of the head, crested, tufted. —चूडा-वन, अम्, n., N. of a mountain. —चूडावलम्बिन् (°डा-अव्°), ई, इनी, इ, hanging down or reclining on the crest or summit.

चेद्: चेद् चेद् (originally 2. च + इद्), a compound particle, never found at the beginning of a sentence or verse. In the Veda it is sometimes used as a conjunction, like the simple च, in the sense of ‘and,’ ‘also,’ ‘even.’ But in Vedic as well as classical Sanskrit the most usual sense of चेद् is ‘if,’ ‘although,’ ‘provided that,’ ‘when,’ and in these senses it may be joined with the present indicative (e. g. मह्यं चेद् ददाति तत्, if he gives that to me); or with the future (e. g. तृष्णां चेत् त्यक्ष्यति, if he shall abandon avarice); or with the conditional (e. g. वृष्टिश् चेद् अभविष्यत्, if there should have been rain); or with the potential (e. g. गच्छेच् चेत्, if he should go); or with the perfect (e. g. स चेन् म-मार, when he died); or with a participle (e. g. कर्तव्यं चेत् प्रियम् मह्यम्, if a kindness is to be done to me). It should be observed that in the Veda the verb which depends on चेद् retains its accent. The negative particle न may be prefixed to चेद् either immediately or separated from it (e. g. न चेद् वचः करिष्यति or न करिष्यति चेद् वचः, if he should not make a speech); and frequently the negative नो is used in connection with चेद्, the verb being understood (e. g. दूरम् अपसर नो चेद् धन्तव्योऽसि मया, depart to a distance, if not, i. e. if thou departest not, thou art to be killed by me). Sometimes नो चेद् = अपि न, would that not! (e. g. नो चेद् एवं कुर्यात्, would that he did not so!). Rarely यदि and चेद् are joined together, when चेद् may be translated by ‘that is,’ ‘that is to say,’ ‘namely’ (e. g. यदि चेद् राज्यम् अवाप्स्यति, if, that is, he shall obtain the kingdom). In the argumentative writings of native commentators चेद् preceded by इति and followed by न is often placed at the end of an objector's statement (e. g. ‘ऋग्-वेदम् अध्येमि’ इत्यादि वाक्यम् प्रमाणम् इति चेन् न, if it be urged that the text ‘I peruse the Ṛg-veda’ is a proof, no, it is not so). अथ चेद्, but if; [cf. नेद्।]

चैत्य 2. चैत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चिता), relating to a funeral pile or grave; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a monument, a tombstone, a column &c. erected in memory of some deceased person or on the site of a funeral pile; a pile of stones forming a landmark or boundary; a sacred tree, a religious fig-tree &c. growing in or near a village and held in veneration by the villagers; a place of sacrifice or religious worship, an altar, a shed kept for sacrifices &c.; a sacred building peculiar to the Jainas, a Jaina temple; a Jaina or Buddhist image; (अस्), m., N. of a moun-tain. —चैत्य-तरु, उस्, m. a fig-tree standing on a sacred spot. —चैत्य-द्रु, उस्, m., N. of the Ficus Religiosa [cf. अश्वत्थ]; a large tree in a village. —चैत्य-द्रुम, अस्, m. = चैत्य-तरु. —चैत्य-पाल, अस्, m. the guardian of a sanctuary. —चैत्य-मुख, अस्, m. an hermit's water-pot. —चैत्य-यज्ञ, अस्, m. a sacrificial ceremony performed at monuments. —चैत्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing a sanctuary. —चैत्य-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a fig-tree standing on a sacred spot; the tree Ficus Religiosa. —चैत्य-शैल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Buddhist school; [cf. चैतिक।] —चैत्य-स्थान, अम्, n. a place made sacred by a monument or a temple.
