चैत्र: चैत्र चैत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चित्र and चित्रा), made of the tree called Citra or Citrā; (अस्), m., N. of a spring month or the month in which the full moon stands in the constellation Citrā (March-April); N. of the sixth year in the cycle of Jupiter; a Buddhist or Jaina religious mendicant; a common N. for a man, used like Deva-datta as a general desig-nation for any person; a metronymic (from Citrā) for the son of Budha and grandfather of Su-ratha; one of the seven ranges of mountains dividing the continent into divisions or Varṣas; (ई), f., scil. पौर्णमासी, the day of full moon in the month Caitra and the sacrifice offered on that day; (अम्), n. a monument erected to the dead, a column or block of wood, a tree &c. so considered; [cf. 2. चैत्य।] —चैत्र-वती, f., N. of a river. —चैत्र-सख, अस्, m. the friend of the month Caitra, i. e. the god of love. —चैत्रावली (°र-आव्°), f. the day of full moon in the month Caitra.
चैत्रक: चैत्रक, अस्, m. the month Caitra; (a patronymic fr. चित्रा।)
चैत्रकूटी: चैत्रकूटी, f. (fr. चित्र-कूट), title of a com-mentary on a grammatical work.
चैत्ररथ: चैत्ररथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चित्र-रथ), treating of the Gandharva Citra-ratha; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Citra-ratha; N. of a Dvyaha ceremony; a facetious expression for the pubes of a woman, ‘Citra-ratha's wood;’ (ई), f. a patronymic of a daughter of Śaśa-vindu; (अम्), n., scil. वन, the grove of the deity Kuvera cultivated by the Gan-dharva Citra-ratha.
चैत्ररथि: चैत्ररथि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Śaśa-vindu.
चैत्ररथ्य: चैत्ररथ्य, अम्, n. the grove of the deity Kuvera cultivated by the Gandharva Citra-ratha.
चैत्रवाहनी: चैत्रवाहनी, f. (fr. चित्र-वाहन), a patronymic of Citrāṅgadā.
चैत्रायण: चैत्रायण, a patronymic from Citra; N. of a place.
चैत्रि: चैत्रि, इस्, m. the month Caitra; (a various reading for चैत्रिन्।)
चैत्रिक: चैत्रिक, अस्, m. and चैत्रिन्, ई, m. the month Caitra.
चैदिक: चैदिक चैदिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. चेदि), an adjective derived fr. चेदि।
चैद्य: चैद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the Cedis, a prince of the Cedis; (अस्), m. a N. of Śiśu-pāla, son of Dama-ghoṣa and sovereign of Cedi or Chandail, and adversary of Kṛṣṇa; (आस्), m. pl. the Cedi people.
चैन्तित: चैन्तित चैन्तित, अस्, m. a metronymic from Cintitā.
चैल: चैल चैल, अम्, n. = चेल, a piece of cloth, clothes, a garment; (अस्), m. a moth; (अस्, ई, अम्), cloth, made of cloth; bred in clothes (as insects, lice, &c.). —चैल-धाव, अस्, m. a washerman, —चैलाशक (°ल-आश्°), अस्, m. a kind of goblin feeding on moths and lice.
चैलक: चैलक, अस्, m. a Buddhist mendicant having only a piece of cloth round the middle of the body.
चैलिक: चैलिक, अस्, m. a piece of cloth.
चैलकि: चैलकि चैलकि, इस्, m. (fr. चेलक), a patro-nymic of Jīvala.
चोकुटि: चोकुटि चोकुटि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
चोक्ष: चोक्ष चोक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चुक्षा ?), pure, clean; honest; clever, dexterous; pleasing, delight-ful, beautiful; sung (?); sharp, pungent, keen; [cf. चौक्ष।]
चोच: चोच चोच, अम्, n. the bark of Cinnamon Albiflorum or of another kind of cinnamon; bark, rind in general; skin, hide; the uneatable part of a fruit; the fruit of the fan-palm; the cocoa-nut; a banana or plantain.
चोचक: चोचक, अम्, n. the bark of Cinnamon Albiflorum or of another kind of cinnamon; bark, rind in general.
चोटी: चोटी चोटी, f. a petticoat; [cf. शाटी।]
चोड: चोड चोड, अस्, m. = चूड, a sort of knob or protuberance on a brick or tile; a bodice or jacket; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people [cf. चोल]; (आ), f., N. of a plant.
चोल: चोल चोल, अस्, ई, m. f. a short jacket, a bodice; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people in southern India on the Coromandel coast, in the province now called Tāñjora; (अस्), m. a prince of the Colas; the ancestor of this people is also called Cola and was a son of Ā-krīḍa; (अम्), n. clothes, a garment. —चोलोण्डुक (°ल-उण्°), अस्, m. a diadem, a fillet for the head, a turban or tiara.
चोलक: चोलक, अस्, m. a breastplate, a cuirass; N. of a people, = the preceding; (अम्), n. bark, rind.
चोलकिन्: चोलकिन्, ई, m. a cuirassier, a soldier armed with a breastplate; the shoot of a bamboo; the orange tree; the wrist.
चोस्क: चोस्क चोस्क, अस्, m. a horse peculiar to the Indus district; a horse of a particular and good breed.
चौक्र्य: चौक्र्य चौक्र्य, अम्, n. (fr. चुक्र), sourness, acidity.
चौक्ष: चौक्ष चौक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चुक्षा; cf. चो-क्ष), pure, clean; honest (?); agreeable, pleasant.
चौड: चौड चौड, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चूडा), crested, relating to a crest; relating to tonsure; (अम्), n. the ceremony of tonsure; [cf. चौल।] —चौड-कर्मन्, अ, n. the rite of tonsure.
चौण: चौण चौण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people in the west of Madhya-deśa.
चौण्ट्य: चौण्ट्य चौण्ट्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. चुण्टी), coming from a pond or well.
चौण्डपाचार्य: चौण्डपाचार्य चौण्डपाचार्य (°प-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a son of Ārya who was the author of a commentary called Prayoga-ratna-mālā.
चौदायनि: चौदायनि चौदायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Coda (?).
चौपयत: चौपयत चौपयत, अस्, त्या, m. f. a patro-nymic from Copayat fr. rt. चुप् (?). —चौपयत-विध, अम्, n. the district inhabited by the Caupa-yatas.
चौपयतायनि: चौपयतायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Cau-payata.
चौपायन: चौपायन चौपायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Cupa.
चौरोल: चौरोल चौरोल, अस् or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), N. of a metre.
चौल: चौल चौल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चूला = चूडा), re-lating to a crest or top-knot &c.; (अम्), n. ton-sure; [cf. Gr. σκόλλυς.] —चौल-कर्मन्, अ, n. the ceremony of tonsure, cutting off all the hair from the head of a child three years old except one lock on the crown; [cf. चूडा, &c.]
चौलुक्य: चौलुक्य चौलुक्य, अस्, m. (fr. चुलुक), a patronymic of Kumāra-pāla.
चौलुक: चौलुक, अस्, ई, अम्, an adjective derived from the last.
चौहित्थ: चौहित्थ चौहित्थ, अस्, m., N. of a Paṇḍit.
च्यवन: च्यवन च्यवन। See below under 1. च्यु।

च्यवन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to move, moving, shaking; (अस्), m., N. of a disease or of the demon causing it; N. of a Ṛṣi who was a son of Bhṛgu and author of several hymns [cf. च्यवान, which is the original form]; N. of an astronomer; also of one of the seven sages under Manu Svārociṣa; of a son of Mitrāyu; of Suhotra; of a physician; (अम्), n. moving, motion; departure from, deprivation, being deprived of; sinking, falling, perishing, dying; trickling, flowing; [cf. दुश्-च्यवन।] —च्यवन-नघुष-संवाद, अस्, m. an episode of the thirteenth book of the Mahā-bhārata. —च्यवन-प्राश, अस्, m., N. of an electuary (अव-लेह). —च्य-वन-समागम, अस्, m. a chapter of the Padma-Purāṇa. —च्यवनोपाख्यान (°न-उप्°), अम्, n. the story of Cyavana, a chapter of the Padma-Purāṇa.
च्यु: च्यु 1. च्यु, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) च्यवते, -ति, चुच्युवे, च्योष्यते, अच्योष्ट, च्योतुम्, to move to and fro, shake about, move, stir, move from one's place, go away, retire from (with abl.); to fly from (the hand or the bow-string, as a spear or arrow); to fall off from, deviate from, abandon (duty &c.); to be deprived of, lose (with abl., e. g. राज्याच् च्यवते, he loses the kingdom); to fall away, fade away, disappear, vanish, perish, wane, fail; to come forth from, come out of, flow out, drop from, trickle, stream forth from (in this sense cf. 2. च्युत्); to fall down, fall, slip, slide; to sink down, sink (literally and metaphorically); to decrease; to cause to move or shake about; to bring about, create, make; to cause to go away, to make forget: Caus. P. च्याव-यति, (in the Pada-pāṭha च्यवयति), -यितुम्, to cause to move, excite, agitate; A. to move one's self, be shaken or moved; P. to loosen, to remove from a place, drive away, expel from, remove; to deprive a person of anything (with two acc., e. g. देवी न च्यावयेद् राजानम् प्राणान्, let not the goddess deprive the king of life); to cause to fall: Desid. of Caus. चिच्यावयिषति and चुच्यावयिषति।
च्यु 2. च्यु [cf. च्युस्], cl. 10. P. च्यावयति, यितुम्, to laugh; to suffer, bear (?); [cf. Hib. tibhim, ‘I laugh, joke.’]
च्यवान: च्यवान, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi restored to youth by the Aśvins; [cf. च्यवन।]
च्यावन: च्यावन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to move or fall; (अम्), n. expulsion, driving away; N. of a Sāman; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Cyavana.
च्यावयितृ: च्यावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes to move or fall.
च्यावित: च्यावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to fall, expelled.
च्युत्: 1. च्युत्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of compounds) shaking, causing to fall, removing, destroying; dropping, dis-tilling; [cf. अच्युत-च्युत्, ऋण-च्°, धन्व-च्°, &c.]

च्युत् 2. च्युत्, cl. 1. P. च्योतति, चुच्योत, च्योतिष्यति, अच्युतत् and अच्योतीत्, च्योति-तुम्, to drop, sprinkle, flow, trickle, ooze, exude; to wet thoroughly, moisten; to fall down; to cause to drop or stream forth; [cf. श्चुत्, श्च्युत्, and 1. च्यु for 1. च्युत्; cf. also Hib. cioth, ‘a heavy shower;’ ciothmhar, ‘showery.’]
च्युत: च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, moved, shaken; deviated from, erred, strayed; deprived; removed, expelled, ba-nished; fallen from, fallen off, broken, disordered; lost; fallen (e. g. नभश्-च्युत, fallen from the sky), dropped, oozed out; (in Rāmāyaṇa II. 91, 64, मधु-च्युत is probably a wrong form for मधु-च्युत्।) —च्युत-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a country. —च्युत-पथक, अस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śākya-muni. —च्युताचार (°त-आच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deviating from duty. —च्युताधिकार (°त-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dismissed from an office &c., deprived of a right. —च्युतोत्साह (°त-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has spent his energies, exhausted, incapable of effort.
च्युति: च्युति, इस्, f. quick motion; falling, a fall; falling from, deviating from (rectitude &c.); vanishing, perishing, dying; coming or streaming forth from; falling, gliding, dropping, dripping, oozing; the vulva; the anus; [cf. चुत, चुति, चूत।]
च्यौत्न: च्यौत्न, अस्, ई, अम्, animating, inspiring, pro-moting; a mover, goer; oviparous; abandoned, wicked, void of virtue or purity; (अम्), n. shaking, concussion; enterprise, exertion, contrivance, manage-ment, strength.
च्यौत्न च्यौत्न। See under 1. च्यु above.
च्योत: च्योत, अम्, n. sprinkling, pouring, dropping, fall-ing, dripping (as any unctuous substance), oozing, trickling, &c.; [cf. श्च्योत।]
च्युप: च्युप च्युप, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 1. च्यु), the face, mouth.
च्युस्: च्युस् च्युस् [cf. 2. च्यु above], cl. 10. P. च्योसयति, -यितुम्, to laugh; to bear; to leave; to loose; to hurt, kill.
च्यूत: च्यूत च्यूत, अस्, m. (for चूत), the anus.
चोष्कूयमाण: चोष्कूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bestowing, giv-ing, (Sāy. = प्रयच्छत्, Ṛg-veda I. 33, 3, = द-दत्, Nirukta VI. 22.)
चक्रतुण्ड: चक्र-तुण्ड, अस्, m. a kind of fish (= नल-मीन).
चख्वस्: चख्वस्, आन्, m. an abbreviated perf. part., (accord-ing to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda II. 14, 4. either fr. rt. चक्ष् or rt. खन्, perhaps ‘one who has displayed,’ ‘dis-playing;’ according to B. R. perhaps ‘stretching out.’)
चरितगुणत्व: चरितगुण-त्व; add — the attainment of some peculiar quality or use.
चिच्चिक: चिच्चिक, अस्, m. (onomatopoetic), Ved. a kind of bird.
चिररात्र: चिर-रात्र, (according to Halāyudha I. 108) अस्, m.
चूडय: चूडय, Nom. P. चूडयति, &c., to make any-thing (acc.) into a Cūḍā or top-knot.
चूलिका: चूलिका, f.; add — the hinting of a matter or event by those behind the curtain (in the drama).
चैलेय: चैलेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चेल), made of cloth.
चोरायित: चोरायित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. a Nom. चोराय), acted like a thief, playing the thief.
